articleTitle: Hash Based Secure and Efficient Scaling Approach for Detecting the Diabetic Retinopathy Disorder
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is a serious concern to diabetics, resulting in eye issues if left untreated. Conventional DR diagnostic procedures often lack robust privacy protection safeguards, leaving patient data vulnerable to unauthorized access and change. To address this pressing issue, we offer a novel deep-learning model that prioritizes both accurate diagnosis and privacy protection. The strength of the Efficient NetB2 model is leveraged in our proposed model, which incorporates numerous conv2d layers and activation functions to enable precise prediction and categorization of DR stages using retina images. The Secure Hash Algorithm (SHA-512) is used to produce unique hash values for each image, which serve as secure representations of the data. These hash values not only preserve patient privacy but also allow for the rapid identification of any unauthorized alterations to the stored images. This assures the accuracy of the diagnoses, allowing healthcare practitioners to make educated decisions while maintaining patient anonymity. Validate the effectiveness and efficiency of our suggested approach by rigorous experimentation on a large dataset. Integrating accurate DR detection with content change detection based on hash values creates a robust privacy-preserving approach. The proposed model not only mitigates the risk of vision problems for diabetic patients but also guarantees the privacy and integrity of their medical data.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Water Requirement Prediction for Agriculture Before a Rainfall
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Enhancing crop output and streamlining irrigation techniques can be achieved through the potential application of artificial intelligence (AI) in agriculture. The use of artificial intelligence (AI) approaches to forecast crop irrigation needs before notable rainfall occurrences are examined in this work. The goal is to develop a predictive model that can precisely estimate agricultural irrigation demands based on expected precipitation by using machine learning algorithms and weather data. To provide accurate irrigation suggestions, the suggested AI system takes into account past weather patterns, soil moisture levels, crop traits, and other pertinent parameters. By taking a proactive stance, farmers may minimize water waste, save important resources, and make well-informed decisions about irrigation management.

articleTitle: Power Efficient High Gain/CMRR and Low Noise ElectroOculogram for Human-Computer Interaction and Wearable IOT Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a low noise biopotential amplifier in which a two-stage OPAMP is the central element of the circuit. For every circuit in the current technology, enhancement of power efficiency, area and reduced noise are the critical specifications. Capturing bio-signals is pivotal, given their minute amplitude (typically within a few millivolts) and low frequency (ranging between 0.1 Hz and 10 kHz). Developing electronic medical devices for health monitoring involves employing operational transconductance amplifiers. Yet, achieving accurate bio-signal measurement demands a high CMRR and precision amplification to mitigate input noise and enhance signal strength. The desired performance metrics are gain, power, and noise margin, CMRR, and so on. For this, our design of biopotential amplifiers is implemented in 90nm technology with a supply voltage of 500mV. The CADENCE SPECTRE simulation of the designed circuit dissipates power in the order of 195.28nW with 86.41dB gain at 180 phase, 217.51dB CMRR and 225.02aV/√Hz Noise. These simulated results show a satisfactory amplification of the signals.

articleTitle: Identification of Nutrient Deficiency Based on Leaf Image Data Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The world population has been growing significantly during the last few decades. The demand for rice is constantly increasing with the ever-increasing global population, as rice crops are one of the primary food sources for humans. Increased fertilizer use in recent years has helped farmers to raise their rice production rapidly. Adding too much of fertilizers will have a negative effect on the soil. To boost the rice production, it is necessary to ensure that each paddy plant is healthy. This study makes use of a very practical method to identify nutrient deficiencies (NPK) in rice plants, using leaf imaging and machine learning techniques. The study proposes a framework in which the color and texture features of the image are extracted and then combined to get a single robust feature representation of the image. Classification of the image is done for identifying macro nutrient deficiencies using the Random Forest model, which when compared with Naive Bayes gave better accuracy.

articleTitle: Real-time Data Visualization for the IOT Application using Tableau Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The world of IoT services offers extensive opportunities to connect devices and upload data to the cloud, enabling data-driven decisions, AImodel processing, and dynamic visualizations through powerful dashboards. Big data encompasses descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive analytics, managing vast volumes of high-velocity and diverse data. In today's business landscape, the ability to analyse data swiftly is not only essential but mandatory for any organization. Simultaneously, the ease of use of data visualization tools has been a driving force behind the wide spread adoption of tools like Tableau, which leads the market in this domain. This paper presents a comprehensive account of creating interactive visualizations for real-time data from IoT applications, utilizing Tableau as a business intelligence tool. It highlights the significance of real-time data analytics in the IoT context and showcases how interactive visualizations can provide valuable insights and facilitate prompt decision-making. By leveraging the capabilities of IoT services, cloud connectivity, bigdata analytics, and Table au, organizations can unlock the potential of their data, leading to better performance and a competitive edge into day's fast-paced business environment.

articleTitle: Role of Non Fungible Tokens in Transforming Academic Credentials for Trust and Transparency
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Blockchain technology in education offers immutable records of academic achievements, ensuring secure storage and verification of credentials. It enables transparent, decentralized systems for certification, fostering trust, eliminating fraud, and providing individuals with greater control over their educational data and achievements. Additionally, blockchain facilitates efficient and instant verification of qualifications, streamlining processes for educational institutions, employers, and learners. The current research explores the transformation of non-fungible items into Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs) and their significance in authentication and verification within the blockchain realm. Addressing the limitations of traditional certificates, NFT certificates leverage blockchain technology to ensure trust, ownership proof, and enhanced transferability. The study extensively discusses the ERC721 standard for NFT implementation, the OpenZeppelin library for smart contract security, and tools like Hardhat, Alchemy, Pinata Cloud, and web3.js in NFT creation and deployment. The research demonstrates the practical implementation of NFT token minting, ownership verification, and transfer operations through smart contracts on different networks, highlighting the significance of NFTs in ensuring secure and transparent ownership in the digital landscape.

articleTitle: Accurate Medicine Recognition and Audio Conversion for Handwritten Prescriptions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Even in today's digital age, many doctors continue to write prescriptions by hand, which could be misread by the patient or the chemist. As a result, accurate medical recognition is required for prescriptions. This research proposes a system for accurately recognizing medicines on handwritten prescriptions and converting them into audio format, benefiting visually impaired individuals. The system incorporates advanced techniques in image preprocessing, feature extraction, and machine learning, utilizing YOLOv4 model for prescription region identification and CRNN-CTC model architecture for medicine name and strength recognition. The model achieves a high accuracy rate of approximately 98 percent and a character error rate of 0.0029. By streamlining pharmacy workflows and improving medication safety, this system empowers individuals to efficiently manage their prescriptions while ensuring inclusive healthcare practices.

articleTitle: Envisioning India's Energy Future: Predictive Models for Power Generation Trends
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: An Accurate analysis and forecasting of power generation have become more important for efficient energy planning and sustainable development as a result of the rising global demand for energy and the growing worries over climate change. This study tries to examine and forecast the power generation trends in various Indian states while taking into account a number of variables, including the availability of renewable energy sources, the consumption of fossil fuels, demographic changes, and climate variations. The study starts with a thorough compilation of historical data on power generation from various sources, including both traditional and alternative energy sources. In order to understand the temporal and spatial differences in power generation across various states, exploratory data analysis approaches are used. Future power generation patterns are predicted for each state using machine learning models that include regression, time series analysis, and ensemble learning. To provide precise and trustworthy forecasts, the models account for the dynamic interactions of variables such seasonal variations, economic development, and policy changes. The analysis also highlights crucial elements that have a major impact on electricity generation in particular states. The study's conclusions are a useful tool for informing India's energy policy in the direction of a more robust and sustainable energy system.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection Using Deep Learning(CNN)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: A brain tumour is a condition in which an accumu-lation of aberrant brain cells leads to growth.Since the brain is covered with the rigid skull, the inner part which is complex and has restricted space would cause many problems. This is very critical disease which causes deaths. Through different reports it has been analyzed that 2400 people die per year due to brain tumor and also it is predicted that, it could be increased by 1.11 percent till 2030. This research focuses on detecting brain tumours with CNN classification techniques. Brain Tumor MRI dataset from Kaggle is used for the study. The study uses five different models to divide the MRI scans into categories such as “tumour detected” and “tumour not detected”, indicating not only the existence of a tumour but also the specific type of brain tumour that was found.Model 5 exhibited the highest testing accuracy of 98.63 %, along with a low testing loss of 0.0534, positioning it as the best model.

articleTitle: Software Defect Prediction by Logistic Regression with Gradient Descent Cost Computation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Ever since software development, bug free software is major challenge to all software industry. Both software developers and testers require ongoing enhancements to their development and testing processes to deliver high-quality software. Early detection and assessment of software project failure can aid in improving project outcomes and guiding them towards success. During the software development process, several risks could have an impact on the project and perhaps cause it to fail. Making a distinction between classes with and without defects from continuous defect counts is common procedure, when developing defect prediction model and apply it as a class attribute. Regression models could be used to create defect classifiers by categorizing the projected defect counts into classes that are defective and non-defective. In this study we developed model for bug prediction by computing Gradient Descent and cost value for Logistic regression. We have performed our experiment on CM1 defect dataset and result shows that logistic regression gives good accuracy for defect prediction when used with Gradient Descent and cost function. We therefore recommend that regression-based classifiers should be used for further defect classification research, especially in cases when the modelled dataset's defective ratio is miserable.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Automated Wheelchair with Lane Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: A wheelchair is a revolutionary assistive mobility aid that improves the flexibility and standard of life for those with mobility limitations. There are many guidance systems for impaired people to navigate against obstacles and other dangers that are confronted rapidly and safely. With the developments of modern techniques, there are many distinct kinds of devices available to help with mobility. The key objective of the proposed study is to create a technologically intelligent wheelchair that can recognize voice, gesture, facial, lane, and gaze in a natural setting for individuals who have mobility impairments. In this paper, an automatic wheelchair based on lane detection is shown, which is made in real-time using hardware through the use of deep learning algorithms and image manipulation. The device also promotes overall well-being with health-tracking capabilities. It also offers communication support for those unable to speak. Empower Wheel Chair redefines accessibility, providing users with newfound freedom, convenience, and connection in their daily lives.

articleTitle: AI-Optimized Eco-Charge Regeneration Technology in EV
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: In the modern era of transportation, improving the energy efficiency poses to be one of the major challenges faced by electric vehicles (EVs). When drivers apply brakes the braking systems convert kinetic energy into heat which leads to loss of power and energy. This loss of power hinders the performance and range optimization of EVs. In order to solve this problem, there is a need to find solutions that helps in increasing energy efficiency in EVs. This paper suggests a solution that can be used in optimizing the energy recovered during braking using Artificial Intelligence (AI). The application of AI algorithms helps in redirecting the kinetic energy to the battery resulting in an enhanced energy regeneration process. The proposed AI optimized aims to overcome the limitations of the traditional energy recovery systems. Through real time data-analysis and adaptable control, the AI system maximizes the conversion of energy and ultimately improves both the energy efficiency and range of anxieties. This approach not only deals with the setbacks of existing braking systems, but also cope with the increasing demand for sustainable technologies EVs. The integration of AI into the process of energy recovery and optimization leads to a transformation in electric vehicle technology.

articleTitle: Face Recognition Based On Fusion Feature Extraction Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Biometric-based methods have emerged as a highly promising avenue for individual recognition, with face recognition standing out as a key application in image analysis. Facial recognition systems are affected by various image condition factors, including expressions, occlusion, poses, and illuminations. It is crucial to consider reasonable variations in illumination between gallery and probe images when developing face recognition algorithms. In the context of face verification, illumination variation significantly influences the likelihood of misclassification. Existing research lacks a focus on imaging conditions, especially regarding illumination, in face recognition systems. This research aims to identify and design a scheme to address illumination variation in facial recognition. The proposed scheme will undergo analysis and evaluation to assess its accuracy and effectiveness. The image processing in this research is divided into two phases. The first is the preprocessing phase, encompassing auto contrast balancing and noise reduction. The second phase is face processing, which involves illumination normalization, face detection, feature extraction, and face recognition. Two datasets are utilized: the first being the ORL dataset, which includes images with illumination variations, and the second being the Yale database, where images contain various noises.

articleTitle: Advancements in Quantum Error Mitigation Strategies for Reliable Quantum Computing on IBM Simulators
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: We explore the field of quantum computing and specifically address the crucial problem of error reduction in the context of IBM simulators. Although quantum computing is a rapidly developing technology with great potential, its practical applications are severely hindered by its inherent error-proneness. We tackle this problem by introducing new developments in quantum error correction techniques designed for IBM simulators. In contrast to conventional methods that frequently depend on large matrices or pre-established error models; our technique presents a flexible and dynamic approach. By utilizing several variations of a main circuit, in which classically efficient gates are used in place of non-Clifford gates, we are able to discover the best compensation scheme from scratch for actual quantum systems. The suggested method exhibits great flexibility in handling different levels of noise and different kinds of noise, such as spatially and temporally correlated variations. It also effectively reduces errors on IBM quantum hardware as well as precisely emulated imperfect quantum computers. By offering a thorough investigation of sophisticated error mitigation techniques, this research advances the continuing quest for dependable quantum computations and opens up interesting new directions for improving both the accuracy and performance of quantum computing operations carried out on IBM simulators.

articleTitle: Prediction of Diabetes Mellitus Disease Using Supervised Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Diabetes is a noxious disease which might result in a global health care disaster. More than 46.3 crore people around the globe have diabetes, according to the IDF (International Diabetes Federation), which is expected to rise to 64.3 crore till 2030 and 78.3 crore by 2045. Diabetes Mellitus is an illness that occurs due to increased blood glucose levels. Regular urination, an increased desire for water, and an increase in appetite are symptoms of this. Types 1 and 2 are the most prevalent forms of this disease, and there is also a variety that develops during pregnancy and is referred to as gestational diabetes mellitus. Large datasets are analyzed by machine learning algorithms, which utilize statistical models to find trends. Our primary goal is to assess and contrast the various machine learning techniques currently in use in order to determine which approach is the most effective at producing high prediction accuracy for the huge dataset. The diagnosis of diabetes in an individual is made possible by algorithms like Random Forest, DT, NB, SVM, and XGBoost. In order to identify the optimal methodology, efficiency matrices and accuracy comparisons are computed for each. With this approach, XGBoost gives the 96% and Randon forest gives 94% approximate accuracy that making it much superior to other algorithms.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction of Unprinted Fabric for Defect Detection Using Gabor Filter, HOG and SVM
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: This paper presents a precise and efficient method for feature extraction of unprinted fabric for defect detection using a combination of Gabor filters, Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG), and Support Vector Machine (SVM). The proposed approach utilizes Gabor filters with various scales and orientations to capture local textural features of the fabric at different granularities, enhancing the discriminative power for defect identification. Subsequently, HOG descriptor is employed to encode the distribution of oriented gradients, providing robust features against illumination variations. Finally, an SVM classifier is trained to effectively distinguish between defect and non-defect regions based on the extracted features. The proposed method is extensively evaluated on a dataset of unprinted fabrics with diverse defect types. The experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed approach in achieving superior accuracy for defect detection in unprinted fabrics compared to existing methods, highlighting its potential for real-world applications in the textile industry.

articleTitle: Flood Susceptibility Mapping and Accuracy Assesment of a River Floodplain Using Bivariate Statistical Methods and AHP Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Over the recent decades, the world has witnessed frequent and devastating flood events with loss of life and property. The focus of this present study is the Panchaganga River basin (PRB) in the state of Maharashtra, India, chosen as the site for flood susceptibility mapping (FSM). Various models, including the frequency ratio (FR), weight of evidence (WoE), Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP), and an FA model (ensemble of FR & AHP), were employed for this purpose. To facilitate the study, a comprehensive flood inventory comprising 200 historical flood locations was prepared. The 75 % samples were selected for training and 25 % for testing of the model. The FSM was generated and categorized into five zones namely, very high, high, moderate, low, and no risk zones through the application of ArcGIS software. ROC curves were plotted for validation purpose with AUC values of of 93.6 %, 91.6 %, and 95.5 % for the FR, WoE and FA model respectively. This study provides valuable insights for residents living near the Panchaganga River, aiding them in relocating to safer areas during flooding events. Additionally, farmers in the PRB can employ this information to mitigate various losses resulting from flood disasters.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Channel Assignment Using Optimization Technique in Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Due to their adaptable deployment options and complementary communication features, Wireless Mesh Networks (WMNs) have experienced an exponential rise in popularity in recent years. WMNs, a crucial component of next-generation wireless networking, have great promise for both the academic and commercial worlds. However, the best routing protocols are lacking in the present WMNs. Instead, a lot of WMNs use ad hoc network routing methods, which have various network characteristics as a result, routing is now the most pressing issue that must be addressed as soon as possible. The proposed model used the Ant-In-Mesh routing algorithm and its upgraded version is being developed in this paper to deal with the demanding traffic needs of WMNs. This algorithm was influenced by the conventional Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) approach, which provides an optimum path for best routing in dynamic networks by using Ant colony optimization and improves network performance by removing and reconnecting dead paths in mesh networks.

articleTitle: A Xgboost Optimized Ensemble Model for Remaining useful Life Prediction of Aircraft Turbofan Engines
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Proactive maintenance for the optimized lifecycle of equipment is now effortless via condition monitoring and fault diagnosis. Recognition and avoidance of a state of failure help to achieve solidity and reliability. Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (ML) forecast such situations and aid in the prevention of economic and safety emergencies. This work reviews such ML algorithms and ML models that help diagnose faults in Turbofan engines via measurement of the Remaining Useful Life parameter. This proposed an ensemble machine-learning model optimized by Extreme Gradient Boosting. The approach is then evaluated via different metrics and their performance is measured to current innovative methods. The system is useful for all processes that require high reliability quality and efficiency and reduces unplanned downtime, maintenance costs and asset quality.

articleTitle: Optimized Vedic Multiplier Using 3nm Nanosheet Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Nanosheet FET technology is an alternative to FinFET and CMOS technology as it gives low leakage current and low power consumption. NS-FET has better mobility and scaling compared to CMOS technology. Multiplier is an important arithmetic circuit required in many digital arithmetic applications. Area, power-efficient multiplier is the need of ALU. Vedic sutras not only reduce hardware but also improve parameters like power and delay. This paper explains the implementation of Vedic arithmetic circuits of 3 nm NS-FET technology in physical layout. The proposed designs are implemented in Micro wind EDA 3.9 with 3 nm deep submicron technology post layout. The values of model parameters are used from the current Berkeley 4 short channel model (BSIM-CMG). The performances of the Ex-OR gate, 2-bit Vedic multiplier are analyzed. Analyzed results show that the proposed I design of Vedic Multiplier shows 96.40% and the proposed II design shows 117.82% power reduction compared to the 14nm VM.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Approaches for Multiclass Identification and Classification of Alzheimer's Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease is a degenerative neurological condition which progressively impairs cognitive abilities and memory. Immediate prediction of Alzheimer's disease is crucial for timely intervention and treatment. This research paper presents a comprehensive approach for predicting Alzheimer's disease using Gray-Level Cooccurrence Matrix (GLCM) with machine learning (ML) models (K - nearest neighbour (KNN), Random Forest and Decision Tree), pretrained models(Xception, DenseNet-121, ResNet-50), and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN).The study utilizes a dataset obtained from Kaggle, which includes MRI images categorized into four different classes. The dataset is utilized to develop and assess different algorithms and techniques aimed at accurately predicting Alzheimer's disease. Texture features extracted from brain imaging data using GLCM are used as input for the machine learning models. Pretrained models are fine-tuned using transfer learning, and a CNN model is developed for direct feature learning. Performance of these models is compared, providing insights into their effectiveness for the prediction.

articleTitle: A Novel Natural Language Processing Based Model for Plagiarism Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: In order to detect plagiarism in academic and professional contexts, this work presents an intelligent Natural Language Processing (NLP) method. The program outperforms conventional exact match algorithms by utilizing sophisticated NLP techniques, robust preprocessing and semantic analysis. It employs AHP, examines linguistic complexity, and identifies paraphrasing. Inspired by previous research, the strategy examines multi-word phrases and how frequently they are used to gain a more in-depth understanding. We contrast reputable and suspicious studies, assigning varying weights to different areas. Our comprehensive analysis demonstrates that the program performs admirably across a range of topic areas, improving plagiarism detection and maintaining the integrity of academic papers.

articleTitle: Analysis of Hyper-Threading Technology Using On-Die Performance Monitoring Counters
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Performance Monitoring Counters (PMC) are hardware counters present in cores of the Central Process Unit. There are two types of counters, 1. Fixed counters and 2. Programmable Counters. Fixed Counters counts total instructions retired, unhalted logical processors in terms of reference clock and core clocks. Programmable Counters are time multiplexed to most of the IPs incorporated in the SoC. Top Down Microarchitecture technique (TMA) is implemented for quick and easy analysis of the performance of the System on Chip (SoC). The combination of TMA and PMC has been used for workloads characterization, finding the perfromance bottlenecks and understanding the microarchitecture of Cores and SoC. The paper additionally monitors the metrics, in particular the Frontend Bound, Backend Bound, DRAM bounds and Core Bounds, Bad speculation, and instruction retirements. This paper has taken Hyperthreading technology as an instance to analyse the performance using the combination.

articleTitle: Ingenious Waste Management: Implementing Machine Learning in Waste Segregation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Waste management is a pressing global issue, and the need for efficient waste separation processes is becoming increasingly important. Incorporating Machine Learning techniques with waste separation has yielded promising results and revolutionized the waste separation process. However, this research paper highlights the gaps that exist in the understanding and efficacy of machine learning for waste separation. This study provides an overview of state-of-the-art techniques for waste separation using machine learning, including the use of computer vision, sensor technology, and neural networks. This paper portrays case studies with empirical data from various waste management establishments to demonstrate the potential advantages of machine learning for recycling and waste classifying. Although progress has been made, this article highlights some significant gaps in our knowledge. These gaps include the need for standardized datasets, optimization of algorithms for real-world scenarios, the impact of technology on the environment, and the socio-economic aspects of integrating automation into waste management. The essential and most important tasks of intelligent mechanisms in the digital age is waste separation. Segregation of waste is necessary to apply proper disposal and waste management strategies. The existing systems use drones to identify waste by using deep learning, image processing, GPS, and GSM approaches, locating and notifying the authorities about them. The improvement made is in the analysis and utilize multi-object detection and picture classification to accomplish trash segregation. Waste management may be effectively accomplished with higher accuracy through Machine Learning practices which therefore considerably lowers labor expenses.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach Using Feature Fusion for Android Malware Detection and Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The proliferation of Android malware poses an increasingly significant risk to individuals using mobile devices. The efficacy of conventional malware detection techniques using signatures is diminishing due to malware creators' continuous evolution of evasion strategies. This study presents a novel methodology for classifying Android malware that combines information derived from conventional signature-based techniques with transfer learning-based Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers model. The features that have been extracted are subsequently combined to generate a novel feature vector. The aforementioned feature vector is subsequently employed to train a machine-learning classifier to detect Android malware. To strengthen the feature set multiple ways are used and that enhances the overall performance of classification of malicious and benign applications. The effectiveness of our methodology is also assessed using an extensive collection of Android applications, wherein we attain great classification accuracy to identify malicious software. Various evaluation measures such as accuracy, recall, precision, and F-measures have been accessed that show significant results.

articleTitle: Long Short-Term Memory-Based Next Keyword Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: This paper focuses on a method that uses an LSTM model to predict the next word of a sentence. Based on Katz's Backoff model, it has been designed to improve and further succeed in our previous work. The main intention here is to show how effective the LSTM model is when compared to Katz's backoff model in terms of the number of n-grams required to predict the next word, and it also helps you predict more accurately. Here LSTM is used for processing, prediction and classification. Since the LSTM model is efficient and has been modified to the task at hand, the model offers very highly accurate predictions even though have used only a tiny portion of the entire corpus. When comparing the existing model, the proposed model predicts the word with accuracy of 90%.

articleTitle: Evolution of Methodologies and Comparative Analysis of Different Development Paradigms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The effectiveness of the paradigm relies on structured approaches for defining and designing SMA applications. Consequently, it is necessary to conduct a thorough examination of the leading SMA methodologies to establish a basis for comparing different paradigms. This examination introduces abstract concepts that enhance the level of abstraction and streamline the development of IT applications. The investigation will encompass a range of activities, from gathering and analyzing requirements to deploying and maintaining the systems. Based on the findings of this comparative study, we propose some recommendations for designing a fairly comprehensive SMA development methodology.

articleTitle: Examine the Incorporation of Integration of Imaging Data for Orthodontic Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: This study examines the crucial but final decision about tooth extraction during orthodontic therapy. The oral health and general wellbeing of individuals are significantly impacted by this choice. In the past, orthodontists' knowledge and clinical assessments were used to make these decisions. However, the development of machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) offers a chance to improve the accuracy and predictability of these choices. With the goal of revolutionising orthodontic practise, this study will create and evaluate an AI-based orthodontist prediction model. An informed and accurate approach is required due to the significant effects that tooth extraction decisions have on orthodontic treatment. By developing an AI-based orthodontist prediction model, our research initiative aims to close this gap. This model can be used as a guide for people interested in pursuing careers in orthodontics, in addition to helping the current orthodontic practise by offering insightful information on tooth extraction choices. There usher in a new era of oral healthcare by embracing technology breakthroughs in orthodontics, which will result in better patient results and well-informed decision-making.

articleTitle: Deep Transfer Learning Based Diagnosis of Multiple Neurodegenerative Disorders
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Neurodegenerative disorders challenge healthcare systems globally, impacting millions of lives and diminishing quality of life. Machine learning, particularly deep learning, offers promise in improving disease classification. Using a two-step methodology, This study looks into classifying three distinct neurodegenerative diseases using transfer learning: cerebral ataxia, Alzheimer's disease, and Parkinson's disease. First, we use neural network architectures that have already been trained, including VGG16 and ResNet101, which were first trained on large image datasets. This enables us to extract high-level features that capture important disease patterns and characteristics from medical images. By adapting these pre-trained networks to the unique attributes of each disease, we enhance the model's ability to discriminate between them effectively. We use optimization techniques like SGD, Rmsprop, and Adam algorithm to get the optimized results, we employ a range of evaluation metrics, including accuracy and loss. These metrics provide a comprehensive understanding of the model's competence in accurately classifying patients with diverse neurodegenerative diseases. To make our model more accessible and user-friendly, we deploy it through the Flask web framework. Our research findings conclusively demonstrate that the amalgamation of transfer learning, Flask deployment, and stringent evaluation metrics substantially enhances the accuracy of neurodegenerative disease classification when compared to traditional diagnostic methods. This novel strategy promises to transform the identification and management of neurodegenerative illnesses, resulting in more prompt and efficient patient interventions.

articleTitle: Smart Energy Power Consumption
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The new 5G technology was recently launched in several Indian states. Undoubtedly, it will change the human lifestyle, businesses, and technology, such as IoT-based devices. Based on IOT and its features of scalability, connectivity, machine learning, security, dynamic nature, endpoint management, integration, analysis, and the compact nature of devices, the System can achieve system run time analysis and reduce overhead latency and cost. The topic of “Smart Electric Power Consumption (SEPC)” would likely focus on ways that cutting-edge technology can be applied to increase efficiency and control how much electricity is being consumed in buildings, homes, and industries. Smart electricity system management decisions can be made with confidence with an accurate prediction of the consumption load. The inability of the current load forecasting method to handle time-series data, which leads to poor stability and poor forecasting accuracy, must be overcome. Additionally, the symmetric mean absolute percentage error (SMAPE) to carry out accurate forecasting of the temporary power load based on the LSTM model network over the gated recurrent units (GRU) recurrent neural network. The main characteristics of input data are crucial for increasing load forecasting prediction accuracy for smart electricity consumption. The research is based on basic units of IOT like INA219 and ACS712 sensors and provides time-serious data to SEPC. Finally, LSTM and GRU predict the overall electricity consumption based on historical data and current data.

articleTitle: Prediction of Human Emotions Based on Speech Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: In this article, we present a new method for understanding human emotions by analyzing speech using neural networks. Our method uses the power of deep learning to derive features from raw speech data without the need for artificial intelligence. We evaluate our approach based on big data and achieve the best performance in case of knowledge for basic needs. Our results show that the deep learning process can remove distinguishing features from speech to cognitive recognition and improve the traditional process. This article contributes to the study of cognitive psychology through discourse analysis and demonstrates the potential of deep learning in this field. Speech is a powerful tool for communicating emotions, and understanding people's emotions by analyzing speech can have important applications in many areas. In this article, we propose a method for combining speech and data for cognitive recognition. Our approach involves extracting text from speech data using natural language processing techniques and combining it with acoustic features. We then use a deep neural network model to classify emotions. We evaluated our method on a large dataset and achieved 83% accuracy in identifying six features. Our results show the effectiveness of communication and information in cognitive theoryand the potential of linguistic techniques in thisfield.

articleTitle: Intelligent Override Adaptive Traffic Signal Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The objective of this project is to design a cost-effective device to enable vehicle actuation and ATCS compatibility in traditional fixed time controller. This Device upgrades the existing pre-timed Road traffic signal controller to traffic responsive ATCS compatible vehicle actuated controller by interfacing a vehicle actuation Enabler module (IoATC) without replacing existing controller and cabling, so that the pre-timed traffic signal will operate in a fully vehicle actuated mode by generating optimum cycle time based on the real time demand using vehicle detector. Inputs required for the Enabler module is connection from one green lamps corresponding to stages, Auto manual switch, Pushbutton for manual stage advance, from the existing Pre timed controller and isolated vehicle detector output from vehicle detector (high / low) through dry contact. Also it communicates with dashboard where real time status monitored and controlled from control room.

articleTitle: GIS-GNSS Integrated Cost Efficient Static Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Managing and monitoring static or fixed assets in real-time is a challenging job that requires frequent field visits, maintenance of the periodical records etc. This paper presents a method for dashboard-based fixed asset monitoring that displays the precise locations of each of the assets on a map and the temporal variation of the attributes of every asset. To implement the model trees on an academic campus have been used as a study. Tress and forests are an integral part of the ecosystem having immense commercial value and therefore requiring scientific management to extract the maximum benefits. This paper describes a method of tree management in a plantation integrating location information obtained from the Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) Real Time Kinematic (RTK) technique integrated with the Geographical Information System (GIS) in terms of quality, cost, and applicability. A real-time dashboard-based tree monitoring interface is successfully developed based on the collected datasets that show the precise location of the trees in a plantation and provide an interactive facility to display the condition of any tree in a plantation or the temporal variation of the tree characteristics over the observation period. The concept developed using tree management in a plantation can be used for time and cost-efficient management of real-time static geolocation-enabled assets distributed over a large geographic area.

articleTitle: Efficacy of an Augmented Reality Application for Enhanced Learning of 3D Geometric Shapes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The visualization of mathematical shapes of geometry is essential to grasp the root of the relevant concepts. Without completely visualizing the shape one cannot relate hence retain the concepts related to the shapes such as area, perimeter or volume for a longer time span. This research article explores the design, development, and evaluation of an Augmented Reality (AR) application aimed at enhancing the learning experience of 3D geometric shapes. The integration of AR technology into educational settings has the potential to revolutionize traditional teaching methods by providing immersive and interactive learning experiences. The primary objective of this study is to investigate the effectiveness of an AR application in facilitating the understanding and retention of 3D geometric shapes among learners. The application incorporates interactive features, allowing users to manipulate and explore geometric shapes in real-time. A user-centered design approach was adopted in the development process, taking into consideration the cognitive aspects of learning and user experience. The findings of this study aim to contribute valuable insights to the fields of educational technology and cognitive science, providing evidence on the efficacy of AR applications for learning complex spatial concepts. The research outcomes may inform educators, instructional designers, and developers in optimizing AR-based learning tools for geometry education. Ultimately, the integration of AR into educational practices may foster a more interactive and engaging learning environment, promoting a deeper understanding of abstract mathematical concepts.

articleTitle: Development of Code-Mixed Marathi-English Dataset for Hate Speech Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: In India, people commonly use a mix of English and their regional languages on social media, resulting in a substantial amount of code-mixed content. As of the present date, there is only a limited number of hate speech code-mixed datasets available for Indian languages, including Hindi-English, Bengali-Hindi, Malayalam-English, and Tamil-English. However, there are no resources or datasets available for Marathi-English code-mixed data with hate speech labels. This paper introduces a novel gold standard corpus for sentiment analysis of code-mixed text in Marathi-English, annotated by voluntary annotators. The gold standard corpus achieved an impressive Krippendorff's alpha score of above 0.9 for the dataset. Utilizing this new corpus, the paper establishes a benchmark for sentiment analysis in Marathi-English code-mixed texts.

articleTitle: Number Plate Recognition Using OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The advancement of automated number plate recognition (ANPR) systems has garnered noteworthy attention in recent times owing to their diverse applications across multiple domains, including traffic management, parking management, and law enforcement. This paper presents an innovative ANPR method using OpenCV, an open-source computer vision library. Developing ANPR systems is a great fit for OpenCV since it offers a flexible platform for image processing and computer vision tasks. The suggested method effectively detects and recognizes number plates from images and video streams by utilizing OpenCV's capabilities for feature extraction, image preprocessing, and machine learning. Character segmentation, optical character recognitlon (OCR), and licence plate localization are important stages in the process. The ANPR system's accuracy and effectiveness are increased by using these strategies. A variety of real-world datasets, including different lighting conditions, camera angles, and vehicle types, are used in extensive experiments to assess the system's performance. The outcomes show how well the OpenCV-based ANPR system performs in tasks requiring license plate recognition, attaining high accuracy and resilience. Additionally, covered in the paper are possible uses for the ANPR system in security systems, vehicle tracking, and traffic monitoring. To make sure the system is workable in a variety of situations, scalability and real-time implementation are also taken into account.

articleTitle: UAV Assisted Next Generation Wireless Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: One paradigm shift that has opened up new possibilities for connection and service provision is using Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) in wireless communication networks. The main features and developments of next-generation wireless communication networks are helped by unmanned aerial vehicles. Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) deployment in wireless networks brings a new, adaptable architecture that solves problems with old ground-based systems. Using UAVs, it is possible to increase network performance by optimizing resource allocation, expanding coverage to remote places, and establishing temporary communication links. In this paper, we take a look at unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and their possible deployment for optimal threshold limit by calculating signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and frame error rate (FER), problems, and solutions in next-gen wireless communication networks.

articleTitle: Security Camera with Frame Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Security cameras are widely used for surveillance and monitoring purposes, but they often require human intervention to analyze the captured images and videos. In this paper, we review a project that aims to develop a smart security camera system that can automatically detect and track objects of interest using computer vision techniques. The project uses the following python libraries: cv2 for image processing and object detection, winsound for sound alerts, tkinter for graphical user interface, threading for concurrent execution, and PIL for image manipulation. The system runs on a python IDE such as pycharm and uses the built-in camera of the device. We describe the main features of the system, as well as the difficulties and constraints faced throughout the designing procedure. We also discuss the potential applications and future improvements of the system.

articleTitle: Redefining Security: Unveiling the Vulnerabilities of Captcha Mechanisms Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The goal of the research is to develop a security breach for text and image-based Completely Automated Public Turing Test to Tell Computers and Humans Apart (CAPTCHA) using Deep Learning. CAPTCHA is a task used in computers to differentiate humans from machines by employing a short code. If a short code can solve that challenge and the human form succeeds in executing the submitted application, then the main motive is achieved. Therefore, the main goal is to overcome the limitations of picture and text captcha and make an automatic CAPTCHA breaker that can easily handle text and picture-based captcha without any human intervention. Additionally, the research aims to break down various types of captchas, including numeric and letter captures as well as hollow, open, and closed captures. In the context of picture-based captcha, the system gives a fixed number of pictures to form a composite unit picture. The user can select the picture that he or she wants to illustrate by clicking on the image.

articleTitle: SkyStrokes: Bridging Artistic Expression and Communication Barriers Through Aerial Digital Canvas
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: This endeavors to address pressing societal concerns by introducing innovative solutions. It confronts the challenges of communication barriers encountered by the hearing-impaired, the excessive reliance on smartphones, and the environmental impact of paper waste. Through the implementation of “on-air writing,” an application is proposed that tracks object movements, enabling users to draw on a computer screen by simply waving their hands. By merging technology and social responsibility, this initiative strives to empower the deaf and mute community while advocating for eco-conscious practices. In doing so, it not only revolutionizes communication but also encourages a more inclusive, tech-savvy, and environmentally aware world.

articleTitle: Sign Language Gestures Recognition using CNN and Inception v3
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Sign Language Recognition (SLR) tends to overcome the communication barrier between normal people and persons who lack the sense of hearing and the ability to speak. Recognition of sign language gestures using deep learning involves recognizing and translating hand gestures and movements into corresponding alphabets or speech through computer vision. This research paper gives an overview of the advancements in SLR techniques, such as datasets, preprocessing, feature extraction methods, classifiers and applications. The proposed method uses Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Inception v3 algorithms which have demonstrated favorable results in the domain of image-based recognition tasks. This paper aims to enhance the performance and accuracy of sign language gesture recognition models. Inception v3 algorithm gave accuracy of 98.94% as compared to previous other approaches. Accurate recognition of sign language will have a very powerful social impact that will ease the communication with differently abled people.

articleTitle: Efficient Feature Extraction and Segmentation Methods Used in Tuberculosis Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: According to X-ray images, the segmentation and classification with noise removal are the major stages. When seen from different perspectives or in various lighting conditions, the chest image appears differently. This paper discusses the major threat that tuberculosis poses across the globe. Although there are many different medical treatments available, TB diagnosis is still challenging. Several clinical and diagnostic processes in earlier poster anterior chest radiographs contain computationally developed algorithms that simplify scientific diagnostic analysis by utilizing image acquisition. It is possible that a digital image will be required for the analysis and annotation of the patient's demographic information while TB is being screened via chest radiography. Special screening processes for victimization. This work proposed a novel detection model of tuberculosis. Initially, analyzed the input noises after that median filter performing pre-processing followed by watershed mechanism performing segmentation. Next, the feature extraction is carried out via GLCM feature extraction model and the support vector machine (SVM) classifying the normal and tuberculosis. The Kaggle dataset with the MATLAB software handled the implementation part and it describes that the proposed work performances are higher than existing works.

Author Keywords: GLCM Features and Support Vector Machine

articleTitle: ANN Based Approach for Electricity Theft Detection in Single Phase Energy Meters
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The major challenges being faced by Power Distribution Utility today are high Aggregate Technical (AT&C) Losses, bad debts, financial liabilities and aging infrastructures. Electricity theft remains a significant challenge in power sector resulting substantial financial losses for utilities and adverse social consequences. Although the AT&C losses have been reduced significantly over past two years, there is a need to further minimize these losses. Due to large database, the utilities find it difficult to implement conventional methods of theft detection. It is therefore essential to develop Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning based algorithms to tackle this situation. This research paper presents an innovative solution utilizing Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) to detect theft of electricity in case of a single phase meter. The real world data taken from the regions of Maharashtra state in India and consumer profiles are employed to validate the effectiveness of the approach. The proposed methods are novice, simple, cost effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Investigation of Methods to Improve the Performance of Frequency Reconfigurable Antenna for Future Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The paper demonstrates the design and implementation of a novel UWB frequency reconfigurable antenna and various methods that can used to improve its performance. The designed antenna operates in the UWB range covering the frequency range between 3.1-10.6 GHz. The antenna demonstrates good results for return loss (S11) < -10 dB, and VSWR less than 1.5. Multiband, multi-functional, and reconfigurable are the three main characteristics of the antenna presented in this paper. Further, the paper highlights the various approaches that can be used to improve the antenna performance, which include the use of Defected Ground Structures (DGS), Partial ground mechanisms, Loading the radiating patch with slots and slits, etc. The arrangement of partial ground, radiating patch loaded with slots and slits produces five operating bands (4, 4.62, 7.21, 9.8, and 12.17 GHz) which finds applications for WiMAX, Satellite communication for C, X, and Ku bands, Microwave links, Medical Imaging, Scientific research, Remote sensing, cognitive radio, and Radar systems.

articleTitle: Agrobot for Inter-Row and Intra-Row Weeding
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Strengthening the backbone of small farmers by developing small-sized automated machines will strengthen India as labour is scarce nowadays. Weeds are undesirable plants in a farm that substantially reduce crop yield and quality. Farmers often spend a lot of resources to reduce their impact unsuccessfully. Weed control costs 33% of the total cost of cultivation. Though intra-row weeds are 25% and inter-row weeds are 75% of the total weeds present on the farm, intra-row weeds are more dangerous than inter-row weeds. Also, they are difficult to remove. The proposed autonomous weeder is a prototype model that operates on a rechargeable electric battery. While going through a row, weeds are removed between two rows by flat and sharp blades (inter-row operation) on both sides. Simultaneously photos of space between two crops in one row are captured by the camera. Image processing and classification are done using Raspberry Pi, a machine learning model, and artificial intelligence. The detected weeds are removed by flat and sharp blades weeding tool attached to the mechanical linkage centrally (intra-row operation). Raspberry Pi is also used for controlling the pneumatic actuator, and motor. Testing of the machine in farms is in progress.

articleTitle: Unusual Human Behavior Analysis Using the Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The significance of abnormal event identification in video surveillance scenarios is receiving a lot of attention. There can be many purposes where these results can be utilized. It can be employed at railway stations, airports, malls, banks and hospitals for monitoring. Real-life events are frequently classified as normal or abnormal depending on their context. There are various approaches to detect the abnormities, from traditional method to deep learning. The difficulty of solving this problem is increased by the absence of samples with anomalous labels and it also increases model complexity. The present model tries to solve major issues like computational complexity and workload management. This study looks for real-world anomalies in CCTV footage, including abuse, assault, property damage, violence, blasting, and theft. These anomalies have a significant effect on human security and safety. Additionally, this work offers a cost effective deep learning method using CNN and LSTM for identifying abnormalities in acquired videos. This implementation is done with UCF crime dataset. The cascaded model gives 98.5% accuracy for detection six unusual activities.

articleTitle: Dynamic Human Activity Recognition with Vision-Based Pose Estimation and Machine Learning for Various Age Groups
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Human activity recognition is evident in medical institutions, survey systems, security monitoring, and human-computer interaction study fields, This article is related to classifying six basic human-centered behaviors (Punch, stand, sitting, squat, wave, and kick) by implementing machine learning algorithms, Logistic Regression CV and Random Forest algorithm, and SVM classifier Machine learning algorithms are used for the human activity classification. We have used a vision-based algorithm using skeleton pose estimation for feature extraction. We have presented results across age groups of adolescence, adult, and middle age. The dataset used is obtained from a public repository and handled using Open Pose (Kaggle). Human activity computing is an up-and-coming research to interpret individual behavior and make an effort to understand its societal context. The results show the mapping of face and body coordinates on the raw camera feed and produce a probabilistic output and a single output defining one of the six activities (Punch, squat, kick, sit, stand, and wave) on the screen. The result is shown in a screen feed of a fixed rate pixel and works simultaneously as the work runs as an infinite loop till the work is closed hence the results are dynamic and keep changing as per real-time scenarios precise, demanding, and agreeable application of collecting context by detecting human body motion information and thereby making intelligent decisions on real-time data is implemented. Here, activity recognition databases are considered publicly available as repositories. We get an on-screen result based on probability which is displayed on the video frame screening where six actions and three age groups (children, young adults. elderly persons) are displayed.

articleTitle: Energy Aware IRS-Aided Wireless Network for Next Generation IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The Internet-of-Things (IoT) landscape involves number of IoT devices for data collection, monitoring and automation. Though they offer numerous benefits but they operate with constrained energy resources owing to limited battery lifes-pan. Thus, energy conservation is very crucial in IoT networks which leads to reduced operational costs with less frequent battery replacements offering environmental sustainability. In this paper, the energy usage of the IoT network is controlled using active IRS technology. The network design involves the use of active IRSs which offer controlled reflection and optimise signal strength thus improving the energy efficiency. A power consumption model is proposed considering circuit components power, transmit power, active IRS output power and amplification power. It is observed that the system energy efficiency improves by 13.04% as the maximum amplification power <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$P_{F}$</tex> is increased from 0 dBm to 10 dBm. In the end, the performance comparison with the passive IRS system is carried out.

articleTitle: Non-Invasive Detection of Oral Cancer Through a Microfluidic Biosensor Using Salivary Interleukin-8 as a Biomarker
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Saliva, a non-invasive oral biofluid, offers a rich source of biomarkers, akin to those found in blood. The advent of biosensors has facilitated the transition from invasive to non-invasive diagnostics. The current study explores the potential of the microfluidic biosensor by targeting interleukin-8, a biomarker for oral cancer towards immobilized antibodies on the microfluidic biosensor. Simulation studies probed into antigen-antibody binding kinetics in 2D and 3D environments, facilitated by COMSOL MultiphysicsTM software. The parameters taken into consideration include the concentration of antigen (interleukin 8), polymer efficacy, surface design, formation of antigen-antibody complex, and length of the reacting surface, which influenced the diagnosis of oral cancer. The investigations revealed greater insights into antigen and antibody interactions and the performance of the biosensor was improved by the reacting surface's linear design, which enabled a quicker flow rate of biofluid and increased the formation of adsorbed species. This research highlights the potential of microfluidic biosensors as a non-invasive tool for oral cancer diagnosis, particularly targeting interleukin 8. Comprehensive simulations enhance our understanding of binding kinetics and also the current work sets the stage for future advances in oral cancer diagnostics.

articleTitle: Convergence of Blockchain and Internet of Things Using Hyperledger Fabric
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) is becoming increasingly significant and has the ability to benefit society. It offers several benefits such as interconnectivity, ubiquity, data generation, automation, real time monitoring, predictive analysis and resource optimization. It can be used in a variety of settings, such as buildings, businesses, healthcare, agriculture, and transportation, among others. Its widespread use makes it a flexible and potent technology. Due to its potential to revolutionize healthcare delivery, improve patient outcomes, increase operational efficiency, and lower costs, the IOT is crucial for the healthcare industry. While IoT-based healthcare solutions have numerous advantages, there are also a number of problems and difficulties that must be properly resolved in order for them to be successfully implemented and used. The primary concern is security and privacy. Integration of blockchain and IOT can be highly useful in various healthcare industry by addressing critical issues related to security, trust, data integrity, and automation. The primary objective of this study is to demonstrate how IOT based healthcare sensors can communicate with blockchain networks to make the whole healthcare eco-system highly secure and efficient. Initially, effective blockchain framework and RPM (Remote Patient Monitoring) sensors were identified. This study deployed Hyperledger fabric framework to implement the RPM system. Thereafter, two experiments were conducted and it is found that there was no packet loss when RPM transactions were sent to blockchain network at the speed of 2 transactions per minutes but the system encounter with packet loss at 5 transactions per minute.

articleTitle: Boosting Wavelet-Based Image Fusion Using Equal Weighted Average of DSIHE and CLAHE
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Image fusion remains fundamental in diverse technical domains such as computer vision, remote sensing, medical imaging, and military applications. With the rapid evolution of technology, the significance of image fusion in research is escalating steadily. Image fusion is paramount across multiple fields as it amalgamates data from numerous images or imaging modalities, creating a unified composite image. Wavelet image fusion is a technique specifically designed to combine information sourced from multiple images at various scales and resolutions. This methodology harnesses the power of wavelet transform, a mathematical tool, to achieve this fusion. Wavelet image fusion finds extensive applications in sectors like remote sensing, medical imaging, computer vision, and surveillance, where amalgamating data from diverse sources is pivotal for decision-making, analysis, and visualization. However, it's important to note that wavelet-based image fusion, while powerful, could be more flawless. It can introduce undesirable artifacts such as ringing and blurring effects in the resulting fused images. To address these limitations, a novel approach has been proposed. This method aims to mitigate blurring effects by employing Wavelet fusion of Dualistic Sub Image Histogram Equalization (DSIHE) and Clipped Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE). Experimental results were obtained from analyzing datasets, including the Multi-focus Image Dataset Lytro Multifocus Images Dataset, using performance metrics like entropy, NIQE, and BRISQUE from which Naturalness Image Quality Evaluator (NIQE) demonstrates the superior effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Advancing Manufacturing Energy Efficiency: The Role of AI and Web-Based Tools
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: This paper introduces a web-based application that simplifies the data analysis processing chain by automating the analysis of arbitrary variables. In particular, our application allows users to easily upload and process data for the analysis of a target variable by exploiting machine learning and evo-lutionary algorithms for precise forecasting and optimization. We demonstrate the system's efficacy using a dataset from a textile company, where our application successfully predicted the target variables with a high level of R-squared of 0.78, using the best regression model. These results not only highlight its real-world applicability but also played an important role in enhancing sustainable manufacturing practices. This innovative application offers a significant step towards sustainable and efficient manufacturing, addressing the challenges of high energy consumption and environmental impact in the industry.

articleTitle: Aqua Watch: A Nitrate Sensor with Color Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Monitoring nitrate levels in water bodies is crucial, as excessive nitrate concentrations can cause eutrophication and potentially harmful impacts on human. This paper presents the realization process of a nitrate sensor with color intelligence to detect the nitrate-concentration dependent shift in intensities of yellow color when aqueous nitrate reacts chemically with acidic brucine sulphate solution. An UV-VIS spectrophotometer was used to calibrate the sensor. A machine learning mathematical was developed. A few of the performance indices such as accuracy (± 98.78 %), sensitivity (~2.5 mV /ppm), stability and ease of use were investigated. The operating range of the sensor was 1–100 ppm (extendable range) with Least Detection Limit (LDL) as 1 ppm. The output from the sensor is fed to the ESP 8266, which has built-in Wi-Fi connectivity and embedded TCP/IP networking software, to process the machine learning mathematical model and communicate the data to the internet for in situ and remote measurements and future uses.

articleTitle: Development of LiFi System for Communication and Control in Hilly Regions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: In hilly regions where cable distribution is challenging and costly traditional communication systems often face difficulties. LiFi technology emerges as a promising solution in such contexts, leveraging communication through visible light. It uses light as a medium to provide data speeds that surpass those of Wi-Fi, This research paper presents an approach for a communication system specifically designed for hilly terrains using Light Fidelity (LiFi) technology. The proposed paper start with an introduction of LiFi technology and advantages of it over conventional communication methods in these regions. However, it also acknowledges the inherent limitations of Li-Fi, such as its low range, which is especially relevant in hilly topographies. The main body of the paper details the system's architecture, comprising a transmitter for sending data, a receiver to receive data, and dual operation: text for sending massage and operate devices, and audio for communication. To underscore its practicality, the system is showcased through two applications: an SOS emergency feature for hilly terrains and a device activation/deactivation application. In conclusion, the paper provides an in-depth examination of how this tailored system functions and its potential benefits for communities and operations in hilly landscapes.

articleTitle: Advancements in Healthcare: Predictive Modeling for Early Disease Diagnosis and Patient Record Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: This study introduces the Medical Unique Identification, a secure patient verification process designed for accessing medical records. Utilizing data mining techniques and machine learning algorithms, our focus is on early disease prediction based on user-provided symptoms. The developed classifier system aids physicians in early disease diagnosis, thus enhancing patient care. The machine learning model is trained on a dataset comprising 4920 patient records, each featuring 132 distinct symptoms. The study adopts the ID3 root-to-leaf approach for constructing the decision tree. Additionally, Naive Bayes theorem is applied to determine the probability of specific events. Patients can select symptoms from a list, and the disease with the highest confidence score is predicted and displayed. The system also integrates systematic storage of patient consultations, contributing to a more personalized and comprehensive patient history for improved healthcare and community services.

articleTitle: Application of YoloV5 for Brain Tumor Detection from MRI
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The research paper introduces an innovative method for detecting brain tumors using a deep-learning framework called YoloV5. This framework is widely recognized for its ability to identify objects in time. To conduct this study, we utilized a dataset called “br35h,” which contains a collection of brain scans carefully annotated with tumor information. These scans were meticulously prepared using the Maksense.ai platform. The main objective of our research is to evaluate the effectiveness of the YoloV5 algorithm in identifying tumor regions within brain images. We emphasize the detection of tumors and highlight the advantages of cutting-edge deep-learning techniques. In order to establish a foundation for our proposed approach, we thoroughly examine existing methods for detecting brain tumors and compare them with YoloV5. Our methodology includes explaining the dataset, outlining preprocessing procedures, and discussing adaptations made to the YoloV5 algorithm to improve its performance in detecting brain tumors. This study delves into training and annotating using the Maksense.ai platform. We discuss optimization strategies and crucial parameters that were employed. Our focus lies heavily on evaluating performance, where we examine metrics like mean Average Precision (mAP) loss, precision, recall, and F1 score to comprehensively analyze how effective the model is. To present our results visually, we employ charts, graphs, and visualizations demonstrating the algorithm's ability to identify tumor areas accurately. Furthermore, we compare our approach with established methodologies to highlight its advantages.

articleTitle: LoRa-Based Wireless Sensor Network Testbed for Precision Agriculture Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Over the past few years, Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) has seen many improvements, and there are various applications of WSNs in various domains. Most communication technologies have a trade-off between distance and power consumption, i.e., to reach a longer distance, high power is consumed. LoRa overcomes this problem by consuming less power and transmitting small data packets for a long distance. The objective of this research work is to use LoRa technology in Precision Agriculture applications to help the stakeholders in better decision-making. A small experimental testbed is set up for precision agriculture applications. This testbed had sensors to monitor pH, soil moisture, soil temperature, and NPK parameters. An Automatic Weather Station (AWS) is set up to monitor ambient weather parameters-temperature, humidity, rainfall, wind speed and direction, barometric pressure, solar radiation, and leaf wetness. These sensor parameters were collected at the LoRa Gateway and forwarded to a network server hosting the The Things Network (TTN) LoRa stack. Transmission statistics are collected and analyzed for this application for remote monitoring of agricultural farms for quick and efficient decision-making.
