articleTitle: Integrated Healthcare System for Saline Monitoring, Patient Communication, and Heart Disease Prediction Using IoT and Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The integration of IoT and ML technologies in the healthcare sector has brought significant transformations, enhanced patient care and reducing costs. This research paper presents an innovative idea focuses on developing a comprehensive system for healthcare, incorporating saline fluid control and monitoring, patient communication, and predictive analysis for heart disease. The saline control and monitoring feature employs an ultrasonic sensor to detect fluid levels, with data processed by a NodeMCU. When fluid levels exceed a threshold, alerts are triggered through a buzzer, red LED, and WhatsApp messages sent to medical authorities and a designated relative. The integration of WhatsApp's API bot streamlines messaging. Additionally, to ensure patient safety, a servo motor clamps the saline tube if medical authorities don't respond promptly, preventing blood backflow. The system also includes a glove with sensors for communication among bedridden patients. Heartbeat and temperature sensors monitor vital signs and medical history, transmitted to a software interface developed using ML algorithms and a Java-based GUI. This facilitates data management and analysis for medical authorities, enabling the prediction of heart disease likelihood based on new patient data using ML algorithms. The research paper aims to enhance healthcare efficiency, improve patient care, and reduce response time during critical situations. The key findings demonstrate successful implementation of a comprehensive healthcare system monitoring saline fluid, providing timely alerts, enabling patient communication, and predicting heart disease likelihood. In conclusion, the system utilizes advanced technologies to enhance patient safety, facilitate communication, and assist medical authorities in making informed decisions.

articleTitle: Utilizing Bayesian Networks to Augment Decision-Making for Dengue Outbreak Response in Public Health Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Dengue has evolved into a worldwide concern, affecting countries across the globe. It is an epidemic disease transmitted by mosquitoes and has experienced rapid expansion in tropical and subtropical regions across the globe. The prior alerts about dengue outbreaks can effectively mitigate the impact of disease and facilitate Public Health Systems (PHS). In this paper, we introduce a Bayesian network (BN) based model designed to assess the susceptibility of a specific region to dengue outbreaks. This model aids public health services in determining the necessity of emergency medical team deployments. The primary objective of the proposed research work is to enhance the capabilities of healthcare teams in diagnosing diseases more effectively. In particular, this paper assigns weight to each dengue symptom using the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) method based on data collected in a rural area of West Bengal, India. Ultimately, the Bayesian Network model computes the susceptibility of dengue occurrence within a specific geographical region. The versatility of the proposed model allows for its application in diverse regions, consistently yielding superior predictions of dengue case outcomes. The suggested model not only provides advance warnings about dengue outbreaks but also proves valuable for the public health system, enabling proactive visits to the affected locations.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Velostat, Conductive Fabric and Force Sensing Resistor for Incorporating Safety in Women's Jacket
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Every day, harassment issues and crimes against women are increasing in India. When women are in danger, if there is no chance to access the mobile phones, then women cannot easily contact others for help. Women are affected physically and mentally, and many lives were lost. When affected, women suffer from psychological effects like depression and lowered self-esteem in addition to physical effects. A safety system in woman's jacket is used to detect harassment and to rescue women from harassment before being severely affected. It is also used to detect abnormal conditions in health by using heartbeat and body temperature sensors. Three piezoresistive materials such as Velostat, Force Sensing Resistor and conductive fabric are analyzed in which resistance is decreased when pressure is applied. These materials are analyzed and the results show that velostat is better than Force sensing resistor and conductive fabric. Velostat is implemented in the safety system and the system detects the pressure applied to a woman's body. If the pressure is greater than the threshold level, then the system sends the message along with the location with the help of GSM and GPS modules. In addition to the automatic detection of pressure, a push button is present in the circuit to send the message manually. Temperature sensors and pulse rate sensors are used to measure the body temperature and heartbeat of the woman. The system was implemented and tested with 15 people and it has an overall accuracy of 93.1%.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Decisions: A Machine Learning Perspective on Loan Authorization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The banking sectors are provided with many aspects for their operations and act as the interface for customer requests. The main objective of banks is to invest their assets in safe customers. Nowadays banks are ready to provide loans for specific customers and expect certain requirements to approve the loan requested by the customers. They implement various techniques to select the right customer. Technology had grown enough to handle such complicated tasks more easily. Machine learning technology helps to cope with this. The proposed solution works with machine learning models like Decision Trees, Logistic Regression, Linear Discriminant Analysis, Support Vector classifiers, Random Forest, K-nearest neighbors, and Naive Bayes. These algorithms help predict results by choosing the algorithm that exhibits the best accuracy. The proposed work experiments with classification models with different dataset sizes, building up a model with a greater number of data samples and a smaller number of data samples, and checking their accuracy scores as well. Applying the best option to the loan approval procedure is possible.

articleTitle: IoT Based Real Time Drainage Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Constant drainage system monitoring is essential for the cleanliness of cities. In reality, drainage monitoring crews do not exist in every municipality. It leads to irregular monitoring of drainage conditions. Drainage becomes obstructed due to unreliable observation, which implies an invitation that ultimately leads to inundation. This study examines an IoT-based real-time drainage monitoring system that monitors the condition of each manhole point in the drainage system via wireless sensor networks. Each individual manhole cover operates as a sensor node. The data that has been entered into a database will be presented using a Geographic Information System (GIS). In order to prevent catastrophes, monitoring metrics consist of drainage water levels, the air pressure in the drainage line, the presence of toxic gases in the drainage and the condition of the manhole, which indicates whether it is closed or open, especially during the rainy season. The purpose of this system is to effectively store the data and maintain real-time surveillance of the drainage conditions. The data displayed via GIS is expected to function as a reference for delineating the drainage master plan for the region.

articleTitle: Advancements in Image Caption Bots: A Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) has changed the area of computer vision, and image captioning is one of the many applications that have benefited from these advancements. An image caption bot is an intelligent system that generates a textual description of an image. This research paper will explore the development of image caption bots, the underlying technologies, and the various techniques used to build these systems. Image caption bots are developed with the help of deep learning models (DLM) such as convolutional neural networks (CNNs) the most popular nowadays and recurrent neural networks (RNN s) which is also popular in researchers. Featureextraction has been done from the images with CNN sand RNN s are used to generate the captions. These deep-learning models have significantly improved the accuracy and performance of image captioning systems. During training, the CNN extracts the relevant features from the images, and the RNN generates the corresponding captions. In order to decrease the discrepancy between generated and ground truth captions, the model is trained. The accuracy and efficiency of image caption procedures could be greatly increased by using the image caption bots developed in this research. These systems have several applications and can greatly aid visually impaired individuals in understanding images, assist search engines to better index and search images, and improve the accessibility of social media platforms for users with disabilities. Further research in this field could lead to more accurate and comprehensive Image captioning systems.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Emotion Analysis Using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Emotional analysis plays an important role in improving AI's ability to learn and respond to human emotions. Face emotion recognition is expeditiously expanding its field of research with important applications across various domains such as medical image analysis, monitoring, personal identification, and security and theft alerts in current society This technology enhances human-computer interactions, mental health and well-being, market research, education and training, security, and social robotics by enabling machines to recognize, interpret, and respond to human emotions based on facial expressions. Transfer learning has come up with a promising address to leverage pre-trained models for emotion analysis tasks. In this paper, a comprehensive comparative analysis of various transfer learning approaches employed in AI emotion analysis, unveiling valuable insights into their performance. The main objective is to assess the effectiveness and performance of the transfer learning algorithms, namely Resnet-50, Vgg-16, Vgg-19 … etc. To carry on our analysis, we have used the FER2013 emotion dataset. The model's performance is assessed through evaluation metrics which include precision, recall, F1 score, and AUC. Our experimental results demonstrate that transfer learning algorithms significantly enhance the performance of emotion analysis AI systems. Upon stringent experiment and evaluation on FER2013 dataset, our findings reveal that VGG16 demonstrates the highest accuracy.

articleTitle: Human Pose Estimation Techniquesfor Yoga and Kavayat(drill): A Yardstick Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Human pose estimation(HPE), is the area of computer vision estimating image or video recently received great attention on the spatial configuration of a human body and plays a vital role in several submissionsincluding as action recognition, computer and human interaction, health analysis, and many more. Pose estimation ruins a mainly uncertain problem in real-life application such as Yoga and Kavayat(Drill)(YK) imposes several challenges that are not addressed in the presented methods as over the earlier period; there has been remarkable progress in human pose estimation, driven by advancements in techniques in the portion of computer vision and the ease of use of large-scale annotated datasets. This review paper intentionsisto deliver a comprehensive outline of current research in human pose estimation, focusing on key methodologies evaluation metrics, datasets, and challenges. Additionally, here we discuss the potential applications and future directions for this rapidly evolving field.

articleTitle: Analysis of Carrier to Noise Density Ratio, Satellite Visibility and Skyplot of Multiple GNSS Constellations using Smart Phone for Relative Positioning Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: In this work, we evaluate the accuracy of multiple GNSS observations using an Android mobile device. The results show that, in comparison to geodetic receivers, smartphones' carrier-to-noise density ratio (C/N0) has significantly decreased. Notable changes have also been observed in the frequency bands and constellations. We have seen a rise in noise in the measurements from smartphones. Moreover, tainting factors of smartphone phase observations can also damage the time-constancy and integer characteristic. Long-term drifts have been detected for POCO M2 phase measurements using GPS, Galileo, and BDS. Ultimately, the positioning experiment shows that, even with fixed integer ambiguities, a precise cm-level solution for relative location between smartphones can be obtained. The relative positioning results are very interesting, showing how an advanced an Android smartphone is a inexpensive tool for mapping and georeferencing apps with an RMSE of less than 30 cm. Particularly useful in remote areas with little to no CORS network coverage. The relative positioning results are very interesting, showcasing the low-cost use of mapping and georeferencing software applications on an advanced Android smartphone with an RMSE of less than 30 cm. Particularly useful in remote areas with little to no CORS network coverage.

articleTitle: Image Encryption and Decryption Based on 3D Chaos Maps and DNA Encoding
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: High information redundancy and strong correlation of neighboring pixel values are characteristics of encryption methods like DES (Data Encryption Standard), AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) and other traditional data encryption methods. There is a need for more robust methods to overcome these challenges. This paper discusses an image encryption method that uses DNA encoding rules to improve image security and combination of 3D chaotic maps like Lorenz, Rossler, Chen and Lu systems to create unpredictable sequences using chaotic dynamics. First, the image is divided into its RGB color channels, and then DNA rules are used to encode each RGB channels. Using a key derivation function, a secure key is generated from the image content to modulate the chaotic sequences. The chaos systems are utilized to create chaotic sequence. Sequence scrambling and XOR operations improve security even more. After that, an encrypted image is obtained and saved. Using the key, the chaotic sequences are recreated during decryption, and the original image is recovered by repeating the process in reverse.

articleTitle: Ecological Surveillance and Crisis Management: Early Forest Fire Prediction and Endangered Species Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: In the realm of ecological surveillance and crisis management, a pioneering approach combining some of the advanced machine learning techniques with bioacoustic analysis is to be delved. The proposed system integrates the predictive capabilities of Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCC) and other sophisticated models of Deep Learning like CRNN which is a hybrid and composite neural network architecture that combines elements of both the convolutional layers and recurrent layers, for the dual objectives of early forest fire prediction and endangered species identification. The soundscapes of avian habitats are leveraged for early forest fire prediction, wherein a classification system discerns sounds produced by birds into two categories: Panic and normal. This real-time analysis enables timely intervention strategies in the event of potential fire outbreaks. Simultaneously, the study addresses the critical issue of endangered species identification. By employing MFCC and other sound-based models, the system recognizes and classifies species-specific vocalizations during predefined observation periods. The quantification of hits, where a detected sound precisely matches a trained species' vocal signature, serves as a decisive metric in determining the endangered status of a species.

articleTitle: CTC-CNN-Bidirectional LSTM based Lip Reading System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The CTC-CNN-Bidirectional LSTM based Lip Reading System is designed to address the problem of accurate lip-based speech recognition. To better comprehend spoken words from lip movements, this system integrates Convolutional 3D Neural Networks with Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) architecture and Connectionist temporal classification (CTC). It integrates 3D CNN with Bidirectional LSTM to provide a comprehensive knowledge of temporal and spatial features of the lip movements. This innovation provides a comprehensive understanding of lip dynamics. This model manages to get an accuracy of only 15.8% word error rate and 6.2% character error rate on the test dataset with 92 epochs. In the real world, this technology has the potential to substantially enhance communication for the hearing impaired, as well as safety and user interfaces.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence with Streamlining Payments and Lending for a Simpler Financial Ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: financial transaction and loan management processes need optimisation and simplification to make the ecosystem more productive and user-friendly. The loan and payment procedure will be simplified as a result. Streamlining the payment process aims to make it more easy, secure, and quick. In order to streamline loans and payments, this article presents a new approach to enhancing the efficiency of financial ecosystems via the use of artificial intelligence technologies. Financial data may be preprocessed using Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) to extract valuable features and patterns. Then, we use Variational Autoencoders (VAEs), a kind of data classification algorithm that can learn and reflect complicated relationships, to sort the data. This step aids in the discovery of potential lending opportunities and the more precise classification of transactions. Step two will include making precise predictions about future monetary patterns and behaviours using an improved Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) for Predicting. The integration of these three steps creates a solid basis for an AI-powered streamlined financial ecosystem, which in turn simplifies loan options and payment processes.

articleTitle: FashionVLM - Fashion Captioning Using Pretrained Vision Transformer and Large Language Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Image captioning models automatically generate image descriptions using semantics of the input image. Improvements in image captioning have paved the way for fashion image captioning, to generate more expressive descriptions capturing more attributes of the fashion item. In our current research work, we focus on designing and developing a fashion image captioning model for automating the generation of descriptive captions for fashion items. We call it the Fashion Vision-Language Model (FashionVLM) to capture the multi-modality nature of the model. We utilize a frozen large language model as a text decoder and a vision transformer as an image encoder, connecting these models with a comparatively smaller Querying Transformer. Fashion Captioning Dataset (FACAD) is one of the biggest datasets of fashion items. For fine-tuning on F ACAD, we utilize BLIP-2 pretrain stage two and MS COCO fine-tuned models in three different stages. In Stage One, we use OPT-2.7 and OPT-6.7 based BLIP-2 pretrain stage two models as base models. In Stage Two, we utilize BLIP-2 OPT-2.7 and OPT-6.7 based MS COCO fine-tuned models as base models. In Stage Three, we use Stage One models as the base models for fine-tuning. The OPT-6.7 based Stage Three FashionVLM achieves the best performance compared to the state-of-the-art for fashion captioning on FACAD, providing +4.281 points, + 39.015 points, +5.667 points, and + 3.519 points improvements for BLEU-4, CIDEr, ROUGE-L, and METEOR performance metrics respectively.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Based Deep Learning Surrogate Model for Design Optimization of Microstrip Frequency Selective Surface
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: This paper centers on the utilization of Artificial Intelligence (AI) based surrogate-model assisted optimization methods for having high performance microwave circuit elements such as Frequency Selective Surfaces (FSS). The fusion of the Modified-Multi Layer Perceptron (M2LP) and a meta-heuristic optimization algorithm Honey-Bee-Mating Optimization (HBMO) algorithm was pursued to improve the design of the FSS unit. The M2LP surrogate model offers a unique strategy for regression problems which makes it a suitable solution tool for optimization of complex microwave designs such as FSS. The outcomes derived from the optimized FSS design parameters obtained from M2LP-HBMO models are compared with the findings obtained from the 3D EM-simulation model. The purpose of this comparison was to verify that the response of the 3D EM simulation model, matches exactly with the proposed approach. As a result, it was seen that the proposed M2LP surrogate effectively optimizes FSS designs for various applications within the given domain.

articleTitle: Alzheimer Disease Progression Forecasting: Empowering Models Through hybrid of CNN and LSTM with PSO Op-Timization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: A common neurodegenerative disease, Alzheimer Disease (AD) affects society. Early intervention and personalized care require accurate condition prediction. A hybrid model using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Long Short-Term Memory networks (LSTM) and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is developed in this study to optimize performance. This research uses a large MRI dataset with important neuroimaging data. This study uses a dataset to train and validate our models, enabling a data-centric approach to AD progression. Forecasting involves predicting future events or outcomes using available data. AD causes cognitive decline and memory loss, making healthcare more complicated. Timely prognosis is essential for prompt interventions and personalized patient care. Conventional forecasting models like CNN and LSTM are good at predicting disease progression. CNN excels at capturing spatial dependencies in datasets, while LSTM excels at temporal sequences. We proposed a novel hybrid model to take advantage of both architectures. This paper uses Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), an effective optimization algorithm, to fine-tune hybrid model parameters. The goal is to improve model forecasting accuracy. In this study, the hybrid CNN-LSTM model with and without PSO accurately predicted AD progression. Our analysis includes accuracy, precision, recall, F1-Score, and ROC AUC to assess model efficacy. This study advances predictive analytics in healthcare and offers new ways to improve AD patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-Based Forecasting Market Trends and Guiding Investment Decisions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: This research seeks to aid investors in forecasting market trends and making educated judgements via the use of an AI-based approach. To begin, financial information will be normalized using a two-stage technique including an Improved Hierarchical Clustering algorithm. This method takes contextual and temporal connections into account. The next step is to use Bi-LSTM, a model that may be utilized for both predication and classification. For precise financial data sequential presentation pattern identification and forecasting, the Bi-LSTM model is trained utilizing both historical and prospective data. The methodology's ability to provide valuable insights for educated investment choices in ever-changing financial markets is shown by validation using historical data, which also shows that it is more accurate than other known approaches. By outlining a comprehensive plan for combining clustering and deep learning methods, this study helps move AI-based financial forecasting forward.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Impact of Uncertainties with Fuzzy Logic on Service Composition in Smart Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The primary sector of the Indian economy is agriculture. Therefore, advancements in this area will have a significant positive impact on the economy. Agricultural applications can benefit from enhanced services offered by Internet of Things (IoT) paradigms to efficiently manage data. In order to monitor and measure the provided services, Quality of Service (QoS) characteristics must be managed. This paper has used agricultural information as a service and then combines those services, known as service composition. Real-life agricultural scenarios are inherently characterized by uncertainties that necessitate careful consideration. A Mamdani fuzzy inference system is utilized to evaluate the influence of these uncertainties on services in order to address them. The dataset used in the study is associated with the production of apples in the Indian state of Himachal Pradesh. Fuzzy incorporates three input factors: Management Skills (MS), Farmer Skills (FS), and Weather Conditions (WC), while assessing two output factors: cost and time. The results show that uncertainty has a significant impact on the time and cost of agricultural services, which in turn affects the overall agricultural plan.

articleTitle: Classification of Malware Families Using Transformers and Auto Formers in Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Malicious code in computer programming refers to programs intended to harm a system by exploiting vulnerabilities, potentially resulting in security breaches and data damage. The field of information security increasingly focuses on detecting malicious software threats. Recent studies aim to improve malware detection methods. As the cyber threat landscape continues to evolve, the detection and classification of malware have become increasingly challenging. Traditional signature-based methods struggle to keep up with the proliferation of new malware variants. In this context, deep learning has emerged as a powerful tool for classifying malware families. This paper presents a new method for categorizing virus into distinct families utilizing neural learning techniques. Antivirus is always creating new versions and evolving in the real world. Numerous academics have created solutions utilizing artificial intelligence methods to deal with this problem. But up until now, these algorithms have struggled to adapt to the ever-evolving virus landscape and had issues with incorrect data in the initial data set. The amount of malware is growing at a rapid pace. Certain types of malwares can evade detection by employing various obscuring strategies. Before it infects an immense number of machines, the malware must be found in order to safeguard the machines and the World Wide Web from it. Many studies on methods for detecting malware have been conducted lately. Virus identification, still remains a challenge. Both heuristic- and based on signatures detection techniques are quick and effective in finding known malware, but signature-based techniques in particular have not been able to find unidentified malware. However, for unfamiliar and complex malware, behavior-based, model-checking, and stored in the cloud approaches work well; deep learning-based, mobile device-based, and Internet of Things-based approaches also surface to identify a certain amount of recognized.

articleTitle: Contactless Heart Rate Detection Using Eulerian Video Magnification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Non-contact real-time heart rate monitoring technology has revolutionized hospital heart rate monitoring. Traditionally, monitoring heart rate was expensive and time-consuming. The system uses Euler amplification and deep learning to provide efficient and accurate tracking. Eulerian video upscaling improves motion and color in videos. Standard cameras are used to obtain biomedical information from subjects. By examining subtle color changes caused by blood flow, heartbeat can be measured accurately without physical contact. The system continuously monitors heart rate using Euler magnification to ensure the skin surface changes color due to blood flow. Deep learning models then extract this data for real-time, accurate results. This new approach reduces doctors' workload and improves patient outcomes while reducing costs. With the increasing use of technology and the trend towards contactless solutions, contactless real-time monitoring holds the promise of improving patient outcomes and improving health.

articleTitle: Exploring Hand Gesture Recognition Techniques for Enhanced Control of Bionic Hands
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Bionic hand prostheses are being developed to help patients who have lost the use of their hands due to an amputation. For bionic hands to be used naturally and intuitively, it is crucial to be able to reliably recognize and categorize hand motions. This study provides an overview of the current state of the art and future directions in bionic hand gesture recognition. The techniques of hand gesture detection discussed in this overview range from rule-based to template-based to hidden Markov models to neural networks to hybrid approaches. The difficulties of creating reliable and effective hand gesture recognition systems for bionic hands are also discussed in the research. These difficulties include dealing with noise, unpredictability, and individual variances. Future research topics in hand gesture identification for bionic hands are discussed to round up the article review. These include the use of multi-modal sensors, enhanced feature extraction techniques, and cutting-edge machine learning algorithms. The advancement of bionic hands and the betterment of the quality of life for those who have lost an upper limb to amputation depend on the creation of reliable and effective hand gesture recognition systems.[3]

articleTitle: Adaptable System for Protecting Inhabitants
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The protection of inhabitants of buildings skyscrapers or houses against natural disasters is an important issue nowadays and there is a need to develop affordable and efficient real-time automatic systems to implement it. This paper introduces such an automatic system i.e., Safe PvsE, which has four sensor inputs, as follows: a vibration sensor for detecting an earthquake, an air quality sensor, and a passive infrared sensor (PIR). When the Safe PvsE (People vs Earthquake) system detects an earthquake and a significant decrease in air quality, it will initiate a predefined procedure to protect the people present in the building. It will send an SMS to the ISU about the location of the building and the number of people inside. The subsequent developments of the system presented in this article are mentioned in the Conclusions section.

articleTitle: Multi-Modal Visual Features Perception Technology for Internet of Vehicles (IoV)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: In the realm of the Internet of Vehicles (IoV), this study addresses a fundamental question that causes the emerging trends within the IoV landscape, Previous research in IoV has laid the groundwork but is limited by conventional single-modal methods. This study advances our understanding by incorporating innovative Multi-Modal Visual Features Perception Technology by inputting various images from LiDAR cameras, Radar and processing using ConvolutionalNeural Networks (CNN), alongside single-modal approaches. Through this research, we uncover hidden facets of IoV, promising transformative insights. The implementation of Multi-Modal Visual Features Perception Technology using deep learning, along with single-modal methods, holds the potential to revolutionize vehicular connectivity and shape a more connected and secure future.

articleTitle: Analysis of Pre-Trained CNN Models for Pepper and Potato Leaf Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Agriculture serves as a backbone for human life as well as for the economic development of the country. Major loss in agriculture is mainly due the disease which occurs on the plants. Crop diseases pose a significant threat to global food security, affecting the yield and quality of agricultural produce. Early detection of plant diseases is crucial for implementing timely interventions and minimizing crop losses. This research analyses the pretrained model to automate the detection of diseases in pepper and potato plants based on leaf images. This research analyzes the images of healthy and diseased pepper and potato leaves. The popular pre-trained CNN models VGG-16, Inception-v3 and Resnet are compared and finds the best algorithm for pepper and potato leaf disease prediction. According to experimental analysis, the Resnet-50 has obtained highest accuracy (100%), followed by VGG-16 (99<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) and Inception-v3 (96<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>).

articleTitle: A Meta-Learner-Integrated Stacking Voting Ensemble Network for Cervical Malignancy Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The aggressiveness and death rate of cervical cancer pose a serious threat to a woman's health. By identifying and treating the affected tissues at the initial phases of the syndrome, a complete recovery is possible. The Papanicolaou (Pap) test is a conventional method of examining cervix tissues in order to screen for cervical cancer. Many networks for automated cervical cancer diagnosis have recently been constructed by researchers; however, the large size and poor accuracy of these single models precludes their practical implementation. Our proposal to tackle this problem involves utilizing several Inception networks as base learners and integrating their outcomes by a voting ensemble. This technique is called Voting-Stacking collective approach. The experimental results show its potential to reduce screening burden and assist pathologists in detecting diseases because they outperform the state-of-the-art technologies now in use. Furthermore, a multi-level Voting-Stacking ensemble framework is intended to enhance outcome even more. Utilizing a publically accessible dataset, our model demonstrated accuracy, precision, recall, and FI are 98.30%, 99.30%, 98.49% and 99.21 % correspondingly. The outcomes of the judgments demonstrate that the suggested framework performs admirably on pap-stained cytology pictures.

articleTitle: Towards the Development of an Automated Pipeline for Cilia Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Alzheimer's Disease (AD) is a neurodegenerative disease that is characterized by a decline in memory and cognition, and there is an urgent need to understand the mechanisms of the disease. Primary cilia have been implicated in AD research because of their potential relationship with signaling abnormalities in patients with AD. However, identifying cilia in stained postmortem human brain tissue samples through immunofluorescence microscopy is difficult and can be subjective and prone to observer bias. We aimed to automate the process to reduce the analysis time and the potential bias using a novel preprocessing pipeline and a convolutional neural network (CNN). Our research found that our preprocessing pipeline reduced noise and normalized the data. However, the CNN did not show high accuracy in most instances. A larger dataset is required to thoroughly evaluate its ability to find the cilia in the stained brain tissue samples.

articleTitle: Defect Inspection of Coated CFRP Structural Based on Microwave Split Ring Resonator
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: This article introduces a microwave sensor designed for defect detection, utilizing a novel split ring resonator, with the primary objective of identifying concealed cracks beneath the coating of carbon fiber reinforced polymer (CFRP) structures. The sensor operates by detecting variations in frequency caused by disturbances in the electric field due to surface cracks in the CFRP material. These frequency shifts are used to characterize the width, depth, and length of the cracks. Initially, a unit sensor is employed, which is based on a 50 transmission line coupled feed, to detect cracks in metal structures. This sensor can provide information about the width, length, and depth of a single crack at a time. Subsequently, an array sensor configuration is utilized, incorporating multiple split ring resonators to enable the detection of multiple cracks simultaneously. The sensor's functionality can be switched between a band-stop and a band-pass filter mode, depending on whether cracks are present or absent in the structure being examined. Operating within the frequency range of 2 to 3 GHz, this sensor system exhibits the remarkable capability to identify cracks with dimensions as small as 0.5 mm, encompassing width, length, or height, without regard to their orientation. This sensor system also extends its utility to the detection of large-area metal surface cracks, expanding its applicability to various scenarios, including the inspection of bridges, oil and gas pipelines, and more.

articleTitle: Criminal Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Face recognition and detection technologies are today's world's unimaginable inventions when it comes to experiencing any crime. Security, surveillance, entertainment websites, and criminal identification are just a few of the amazing applications. This system is extremely useful for customer screening at banks, airports, and other establishments. CNN continues to use a facial recognition system, which presents challenges for uses like criminal investigations. This suggests that for deep learning, CNN needs more data (murder, robbery, etc.). This project includes face recognition technology to assist police officers effectively and efficiently. This technology makes it easier and more reliable to screen for offenders. In this article, we put the Deep Learning algorithms into practice to build a system for website-based image recognition.

articleTitle: Smart Survival Lance System for Visually Impaired Person
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The ultimate objective of the field of computer vision is inventing software that allows computers to recognize and interpret humans and things in photos, videos, and the actual world. in accordance to a global health organization, there are approximated 2.2 billion individuals with vision impairment around the globe, with causes of blindness ranging from cataracts to age-related macular degeneration. Due to their visual impairment, these people encounter daily obstacles. Computer vision, with the use of algorithms like YOLO as well as datasets and neural networks, can significantly enhance the lives of visually impaired people. Previous research has made use of technologies such as YOLOv7, Neural Network, GTTs, dataset, and R-NCC. for this survey study is to offer an AI-based intelligent system that improves the lives of visually impaired people by recognizing items in their environment and making audible announcements for the objects that are detected. This suggested approach will make it easier for visually impaired people to navigate interior as well as exterior settings. The sole objective of the current study is to propose a sensible and effective system that addresses the challenges that visually impaired people face

articleTitle: Sign Language to Text Translation Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: People who have hearing loss can communicate through sign language. The sign language will subsequently be converted into text, specifically alphabets. This paper presents the specifically designed Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is composed of eleven layers, each carefully calibrated using exact parameters. These layers encompass convolution, activation, max-pooling, and flattening processes, ultimately leading to dense layers that incorporate dropout regularization. The last dense layer employs softmax activation. In the initial phase, the MNIST dataset undergoes preprocessing steps. Next, numerous essential characteristics of the preprocessed hand gesture image are computed. The ASL employs 24 classes, representing the letters A to Y (without J and Z) in the alphabet. However, there are no cases available for 9 (representing J) or 25 (representing Z) due to the involvement of gesture motions associated with these letters. According to MNIST dataset, total number of training examples are 34,627 images which is divided in to 80% for training and 20% testing, all sharing a common size of 28 × 28 pixels image include gray scale image value 0 to 255. The results demonstrate that the suggested approaches yielded favorable results, achieving a recognition accuracy of the classification 98.75%.

articleTitle: True Feature Distillation for Compression of GANs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The ResNet architecture based Pix2Pix model has a high number of dependent operations owing to the numerous ResNet Blocks. Thus, during the training and inference of the model, a high latency is observed even with powerful GPUs. More layers reduce the number of independent operations, thus underutilizing the high parallelism available in powerful GPUs. The proposed method of True Feature Distillation (TFD) implements GAN compression based on reducing layers for compression along with reducing the filters for increasing the parallel operations in the model and in turn increasing the usage of parallelism of powerful GPUs. Through TFD, a reduced latency is observed with negligible change in performance of the model even with a reduced number of layers in the proposed model. A ResNet based Pix2Pix model is used as an example for training through the proposed method via edges2shoes dataset. Speedup with respect to complete Pix2Pix achieved is 1.58x on the NVIDIA Tesla V100.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Low Cost IoT Based Energy Optimising Meter for Home Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: This research presents the development of a Prototype Cost-Effective Energy Meter, which employs carefully selected components such as NodeMCU ESP8266, ESP32, an I2C interfaced LCD Display, ZMPT101B Voltage Sensor, and SCT-013 Current Sensor. These components were chosen based on criteria including compatibility, accessibility, and suitability for the project's objectives. The energy meter measures both voltage and current, offering precise data for electrical systems. Data transmission is achieved through integration with the Thingspeak platform, enabling remote monitoring. A control system, integrated with Sinric Pro and Thingspeak API, manages room electricity, providing real-time information, control capabilities, historical analysis tools, and insights into energy consumption. This comprehensive system offers a practical solution for energy management.

articleTitle: Soil-Borne Pathogens Management in Cloud-Connected Agriculture: An IoT and Decision Tree Algorithmic Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: In the digital revolution of agriculture, Internet of Things (IoT) technology and smart Decision Tree (DL) Algorithms may help control soil-borne diseases. This research proposes using cloud-connected technologies to combat soil-borne illnesses in agriculture. IoT devices gather real-time data and cloud computing processes in the suggested system and store it efficiently and a DL algorithm makes intelligent decisions. IoT sensors in the field monitor surrounding factors, pathogen prevalence for soil health. A DL algorithm examines the data on a cloud platform to deliver actionable insights. For soil-borne pathogen prediction and management, the DT algorithm considers soil moisture, temperature, and historical disease trends. Farmers get fast and data-driven decision assistance from the cloud-connected architecture's device connectivity and remote access. Simulation and real-world tests show that the suggested strategy reduces agricultural production lost to soil-borne illnesses. Increased disease prediction accuracy and tailored treatment suggestions increase crop health and sustainable agriculture. The effective and scalable soil-borne pathogen control method presented in this study to smart agriculture. IoT and DT algorithms enable proactive disease management and provide the groundwork for precision agriculture and data-driven farming.

articleTitle: Accurate Semantic Segmentation of Aerial Imagery Using Attention Res U-Net Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Semantic segmentation of photos holds importance in various fields such, as security, emergency response, agriculture, urban planning and surveillance. Researchers have shown increased interest in automating the analysis of photographs without intervention due to its critical role across multiple disciplines. A CNN variant called U-Net has been successful in segmenting photos beyond the domain. However U-Nets limited number of layers hampers its ability to extract information from photos accurately and can lead to flawed boundaries for objects with complex features. In this study we introduce an architecture called Attention Res U-Net that addresses challenges in semantic segmentation such as low accuracy, for high resolution images and incorrect object boundary recognition. Our approach focuses on refining object boundaries. This approach successfully balances the extraction of attributes with the preservation of space thereby significantly improving aerial image analysis.

articleTitle: Adaptive DoS Attack Detection in SDN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: SDN is gaining popularity for a few years now. There has been a massive increase in the adoption of SDN, especially with the rise in demand for IoT, and 5G networks which have led to a lot of research in this area. As adoption increased threats have also risen. Out of all the attacks Denial of Service attacks has been most used against SDN. Most countermeasures that are proposed by researchers are specific to attacks on the individual layer and are short-term ones. Most DoS attack detection focuses on Fast DoS attack. The paper proposes and implements an adaptive DoS Attack detection method which detects Fast DoS attack and detects Low DoS attack avoiding any confusion with congestion.

articleTitle: FireLens: A Deep Learning Solution for Wildfire Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: This paper presents an optimized framework for video smoke detection tailored specifically for deployment on local cameras in embedded systems. The proposed methodology exhibits its effectiveness in real-time smoke image identification with minimal false positive occurrences, as substantiated through rigorous experimentation. By harnessing the capabilities of CNN technology, system showcases promising capabilities for swiftly detecting smoke associated with wildfires. The emphasis is placed on the importance of forest fire early warning systems prevention, & the design of this framework is geared towards promptly and accurately recognizing potential threats. The incorporation of deep learning in wildfire smoke detection offers a robust solution for proactive incident management, enabling swift responses to potential wildfire incidents.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Network Security in MANET Using Refined Adaptive Harris Hawks Optimization Algorithm (RAHHO) for IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The proliferation of Internet of Things (IoT) devices in Mobile Ad-Hoc Networks (MANETs) has introduced complex security challenges, demanding innovative solutions to safeguard data integrity and network functionality. This paper proposes a novel approach, the Refined Adaptive Harris Hawks Optimization Algorithm (RAHHO), tailored to fortify network security within MANETs for IoT applications. The RAHHO method integrates the efficient search capabilities of the Harris Hawks Optimization (HHO) algorithm with a dynamic updating mechanism, enhancing convergence speed and accuracy in optimizing security parameters. Leveraging the adaptability of HHO, RAHHO dynamically adjusts hawk positions and updates search strategies, enabling robust exploration of security parameter spaces crucial for MANETs. Moreover, the application of RAHHO in MANETs offers a multifaceted enhancement of security measures. The outcomes reveal varying degrees of susceptibility to attacks, with HHO displaying the highest vulnerability, followed by CHHSO and MU-HHO. RAHHO emerges as notably more resilient, being 73.33% less vulnerable than HHO, 40.5% less vulnerable than CHHSO, and 20% less vulnerable than MU-HHO. Simulation results demonstrate the efficacy of RAHHO in reinforcing network security, showcasing notable improvements in network performance metric such as cost function. The results establish RAHHO as the most secure algorithm in this specific context, showcasing superior performance. The progressive decrease in vulnerability from HHO to RAHHO corresponds to an increase in overall security.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Exploration of the Role of Graph Databases like Neo4j in Cyber Security
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: In today's digitalization world, data play a very valuable role. In addition, with these security is the core concern. Cyber security provides different tools for protecting data. This paper discussed various cyber security tools that are helpful in developing secure online environment. Organizations and governments worldwide recognize the necessity of adhering to cyber security measures. Databases also play an important role in cyber security. However, databases like MySQL and Oracle are relational databases, come with some limitations such as schema rigidity and challenges related with scalability. This has led to the emergence of alternative database technologies, including graph databases like Neo4j, which excel in expressing relationships between entities and are increasingly important in cybersecurity. This paper explores the role of databases in cybersecurity and the significance of the graph model using Neo4j in enhancing cybersecurity measures. We have used a sample (Cyber Security Breaches, 2014) dataset for applying CQL and generating graph model to analyse the data in visual form. The combination of Cypher Query Language (CQL) and Neo4j's graph database features provides a powerful toolset for analysing and securing interconnected data in the digital age.

articleTitle: ICode - An Unified Competitive Coding Profile Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Although a software developer is capable of creating excellent software without the necessity for competitive coding. Having their hands in it may increase the project's efficiency and scalability. For every developer, problem solving is a must-required skill that is gained through competitive coding. Many technical recruiters use competitive programming as a barometer to assess a candidate's potential for the post of software engineer, including many prestigious Silicon Valley companies like Google, Facebook,etc. Since there is no such platform that helps students showcase their coding status on every registered platform, the proposed system helps to have such. ICode is a unified platform to help students visualize their coding profile status on a single site at one go. There is no public API that can be used to retrieve the data.from websites; hence, web scraping becomes relevant in this situation. It is one of the strategies of information retrieval.lnstead of manually copying data from the browser, with web scraping, it becomes easy to automatically extract the data. without any effort and perform analysis on it. The paper mainly targets the visualization of the data scrapped from competitive coding platforms to create a digital resume and perform analysis based on the scraped data. This is a digital resume.will be a revolution in the modern-day recruitment process since it will contain realtime user's details and coding platform ratings. and their analysis, project information, and digital bridges to platforms like Github and LinkedIn, where recruiters can actually review the users's information in a better way as compared to the old paper resume.

articleTitle: Innovative Attendance Tracking: Facial Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Facial recognition is the limelight of today's world and it is recognized as one of the most accurate, fastest and easiest ways for establishing individual identity. Facial recognition finds its applications in various sectors of life which mainly includes security and authentication. This paper proposes a system which uses facial recognition for marking attendance of students. Student authentication using this technology for marking attendance in school, colleges and institutions is a far more reliable and faster approach than the traditional methods of marking attendance. The system implements various python functionalities such as OpenCV along with machine learning algorithms for matching the faces. The paper proposes a system which has user friendly interface along with real time updating of attendance with the help of a real time database. It also provides functionalities such as sending messages to the guardian of the student in case the student fails to attend the lecture and simultaneously allows them to monitor overall attendance. Along with this the system also automatically creates an excel file with the entire attendance list that also stores the time of arrival of the student for the lecture.

articleTitle: Minutes of Meeting Generation for Online Meetings Using NLP & ML Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Within the realm of remote work, meetings serve as unique spaces where individuals summon to exchange concepts and reach consequential conclusions. Currently, they are written down by hand, and while it can be challenging to keep up, occasionally they overlook crucial information. Therefore, automating the process of creating meeting minutes with machine learning and natural language processing techniques has emerged as a promising way to do rid of the tedious human processes involved in recording and summarizing meeting discussions. This study presents a novel method for automating the creation of meeting minutes through the use of machine learning (ML), natural language processing (NLP) algorithms, and several summarization models, including Google's PEGASUS, BART, LED, Meeting Summary, and bartconversation summary. In order to verify the model's functionality, audio clips from different websites are gathered, and the results are computed and compared using the ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, ROUGE-P, ROUGE-R, and ROUGE-F scores. With the aid of the Whisper AI model and pyAnnote, the suggested solution makes extensive use of natural language processing (NLP) to evaluate meeting transcripts. It is specifically made to create transcripts for online meetings, starting with the addition of time stamps, speaker identification, and the assignment of each sentence to the appropriate speaker. After that, the text is divided up into distinct sentences for processing. This technique accurately identifies and summarizes important themes, crucial choices, action items, and other significant details discussed throughout the discussion.

articleTitle: Steganography in the Quantum Era
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The advancement of Quantum information and quantum computing has led to an increase in algorithms and new methods to exploit quantum computers in various domains, such as breaking cryptography, Quantum Machine learning, Quantum Eigensolvers for materials modeling etc. One such way of control-ling quantum computers has led to the inception and emergence of Quantum Image Processing and Quantum Steganography. Steganography has been widely used for secure communication in the past. With the evolution of quantum computing, the exploitation of qubits for image-based steganography has gained attention from academics, government, and military stakeholders alike to improve their respective secure communication channels. This paper aims to discuss a preliminary application of Quantum Steganography using IBM's open source software development kit Qiskit [9] in the Quantum Era.

articleTitle: Safe Count: A Two-Step Verification Based Voting System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The rise in the number of manipulations of the votes and mishandling of the EVM machines has been observed in the past few years. Taking this issue into consideration, a working project has been designed and implemented to improve the voting system. It will help maintain the fairness of the elections and ensure that an ethical candidate comes to power. This project is a blend of two existing technologies, i.e., RFID technology and electronic voting machines. These two technologies can be combined so that more accountability and transparency in the process of elections can be maintained. The project's biometric verification component will boost the voting system's security and precision. Facial recognition technology will make sure that each voter is who they say they are and prevent proxy voting. A cross-reference will be made between the RFID card's distinctive identity and the voter's biometric information to ensure that only eligible voters can cast ballots. The suggested initiative would guarantee that there is no compulsion and lessen the possibility that any electorate will cast more than one or two ballots. It will work on reducing the number of threats involved during the elections. The main motive of the project is to make sure that the election process is carried out in a safer way such that it does not hamper the results of the elections.

articleTitle: Recognition of Critical Built-Up Areas Located on High Hill-Slope Regions using Spatial Data Mining Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: In mountainous places, structures are being built for residential or commercial uses without the necessary safety precautions. Every year, landslides, torrential downpours, severe snowfall, earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and floods cause buildings to collapse. The bulk of them are found in high-hill slope areas with loose soil types, close to river flows and other sorts of water sources. Therefore, these incidents have claimed thousands of lives. This paper deals with the process of automatic identification of critical buildings (residential/commercial) located in mountainous area which are on high-hill-slope, close to river flows, having loose soil type and high variations in land elevation contours. This study use the primary data like, built-up/residential area and water body areas which are extracted from sample LULC (Land Use and Land Cover) using image classification techniques, and another important data like slope map and land elevation contour maps which are generated from DEM (Digital Elevation Model). In addition, the supplementary data like, river maps, soil maps and other base maps, are also collected. All the data are integrated and taken into consideration for the identification and extraction of critical residential/build-up areas using spatial data mining technique.

articleTitle: Enhancing Stock Price Prediction with MACD and EMA Features Using LSTM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: This research paper proposes the application of the Moving Average Convergence Divergence (MACD) and Exponential Moving Average (EMA) indicators in combination with the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) algorithm for stock price prediction. This study aims to enhance the accuracy and robustness of stock market predictions by using the strengths of technical indicators and deep learning methodologies. The LSTM algorithm, known for its ability to model long-term time series data, is used in this research. In this paper, we considered various evaluation metrics such as RMSE, R2 score, accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score. Real-world historical stock price data, i.e., RELIANCE, KOTAK BANK, INFOSYS, ASIAN PAINT, HINDUSTAN UNILEVER, HDFC BANK, VEDANTA, and ICICI BANK are utilized to validate the proposed model, ensuring practical relevance and applicability. The experimental results demonstrate that the integration of MACD and different variants of EMA (26-day EMA, 100-day EMA, and 200-day EMA) features with LSTM significantly improves stock price prediction accuracy. The results show that the accuracy is improved by using the indicators MACD and EMA, as well as basic features such as open, high, low, and close (OHLC) features. Good precision values indicate that the proposed model captures positive events effectively. Good recall values indicate that the model can predict true positive values correctly, and the F1-score is also good, which indicates that the model has a good combination for effectively capturing positive and negative instances. The RMSE is computed on a testing dataset to assess the model's performance. A lower RMSE indicates better performance. The R2 score was 0.75 < R2 < 0.95, which indicated a strong model.

articleTitle: Fine-Tuning ResNet50 for Land Use and Land Cover Classification in the Philippines
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: This study focuses on employing ResNet50 as a base model for classifying LULC from the satellite dataset. Unlike conventional ML methods such as decision trees, RF and SVM, convolutional neural network (CNN) has emerged as a viable solution for image classification, with its automatic feature extraction and effective spatial feature capture. However, the complexity of building models from scratch can lead to overfitting, prompting the adoption of transfer learning. Transfer learning involves retraining a pre-trained model base, significantly enhancing CNN model training accuracy, while reducing the need for a large dataset. The objectives of this study include preprocessing Sentinel-1 synthetic aperture radar (SAR) dataset, fine-tuning the ResNet50 model, and assessing model performance using confusion matrix together with other performance metrics. The model-building pipeline includes ResNet50 input preparation, adding custom layers on top of the base model, compiling the model, and implementing early stopping during training. Hyperparameter tuning is performed using the keras tuner. Results exhibit the efficacy of the method, indicated by high training and testing accuracies and low losses. The final evaluation metrics indicate a well-performing model that satisfies the evaluation metrics. This study successfully applies transfer learning with ResNet50 to Sentinel-1 SAR data for LULC classification, providing insights into effective remote sensing applications.

articleTitle: Decentralized Storage Security: A Blockchain-Driven Solution
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: One innovative approach proposed to address the privacy and security concerns inherent in centralized cloud storage systems is the Decentralised Google Drive Project, which employs blockchain technology. In order to construct a decentralized storage network that is resistant to attempts at hacking and guarantees that user data remains to be private and secure despite these attempts, the project makes use of blockchain technology. Users have the option of saving their data both locally and on the blockchain network, providing them with the benefits of both centralized and decentralized storage solutions. Because of the hybrid design of the system, users are able to save their files in both of the available places. The project's goal is to give users a safer and more private alternative to Google Drive and other centralized cloud storage systems, in addition to offering them additional flexibility and control over their data. This will be accomplished by providing customers with an alternative to Google Drive. The system that is currently being proposed has the ability to not only pave the way for an internet that is more decentralized and democratic, but it also has the potential to alter the way in which we store and manage our data, which may be a game-changer.

articleTitle: With You - Indian Sign Language Detection and Alert System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The global deaf, non-speaking, and hard-of-hearing community relies heavily on sign language to facilitate communication. This paper will delve into the development of a detection system for the Indian Sign Language (ISL) that puts convenience and inclusivity first for this group. To accomplish this goal, the system uses a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) artificial neural network. Currently, the system can recognize 6 dynamic signs, 6 emergency signs, and 26 static ISL alphabets. The emergency signals use certain non-verbal cues to automatically dial the designated emergency services number. The emergency's type, the user's IP address, and their location are all included in the message that is delivered. By enabling communication through ISL, this system has been created to provide accessibility for the community of people with hearing disabilities. The artificial neural network enables the system to acquire the capability of learning and identifying various signals. Additionally, the use of emergency indicators can be extremely important in circumstances when verbal communication is impossible as the system can immediately notify emergency services and give them the information they need, to deliver quick aid. Overall, the hearing-impaired people in India may benefit greatly from this system's contributions to their safety and well-being.

articleTitle: Partitions of Liver Cancer by Enhanced Feature Extraction and Mapping with Improved Transfer Developing Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The liver is the largest solid organ in the body. In addition to these essential roles, it also cleans blood flow of contaminants, regulates blood clotting, and keeps blood sugar levels stable. All blood that exits the stomach and intestines is ultimately directed toward the liver. Infections, genetic disorders, cancer, overindulgence in toxic drugs, and other situations can all result in liver sickness. Medical professionals state that liver cancer may be diagnosed in 1.6% of Indian men and women at some time in their lifespan. When liver CT images are interpreted semi-manually or manually, a great deal of money, time, subjectivity, and error are involved. Many computer techniques have been developed to improve the diagnosis of cancer of the liver, and those issues have been handled. To create a fully automated method that will make it possible to quickly extract cancers of the liver from images obtained from CT scans. Its efficiency in enhancing the diagnostic accuracy of IVGG-19 based CAD is suggested by the experimental findings, which obtain the best classification accuracy of 97.2%.

articleTitle: SensorNet-Cipher: A Lightweight Protocol for Security in Resource-Limited Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The novel cryptographic protocol presented in this research paper is specifically designed for wireless sensor networks (WSNs), which are generally limited in terms of computational power, energy, and the requirement for strong security. In order to overcome these limitations and offer high-level security against a variety of cyberthreats that are typical in WSNs, this study presents SensorNet-Cipher, a novel symmetric key encryption system. The protocol places a strong emphasis on lightweight architecture, requiring the least amount of processing power to carry out encryption and decryption operations. Effective key generation, distribution, and management techniques that are specially adapted for the dynamic and distributed nature of WSN s are important aspects. The use of 128-bit and 256-bit key sizes is covered in the study to provide robust encryption without putting too much strain on the sensor nodes. In order to ensure data integrity and source authenticity, SensorNet Cipher also includes an advanced integrity and authentication mechanism that makes use of an optimized Message Authentication Code (MAC). The protocol is specifically made to be energy-efficient, which is important for extending the life of sensor nodes. SensorNet Cipher's resilience against common security risks, such as replay and man-in-the-middle attacks, is demonstrated by complete security analysis. We also examine how well the protocol scales and adapts to different network topologies and sizes. This work makes a substantial contribution to the field of network security by providing a workable security solution for situations with restricted resources, such WSNs.

articleTitle: A Novel Probabilistic Access Scheme for NB-IoT in 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: As one of the emerging technologies of Low-Power Wide-Area Internet of Things, Narrow-Band Internet of Things (NB-IoT), is facing more and more challenges of massive terminal connections. Aiming at practical application scenarios, a preamble allocation scheme based on Beta distribution is proposed. This scheme first calculates the energy consumption of equipment's each time slot, and divides the equipment into high energy consumption equipment group and low energy consumption equipment group based on the average energy consumption and cumulative energy consumption. And then assign the preamble to the group of high energy consumption devices preferentially, then assign the remaining preamble and the conflicting preamble of the high energy consumption device group will be assigned to low energy consumption device group. The simulation result shows that, compared with traditional random allocation scheme, the proposed scheme can effectively improve NB-IoT, in terms of average access success rate and average throughput of the system, also can effectively reduce the back-off time.

articleTitle: A Video Steganography Approach with Randomization Algorithm Using Image and Audio Steganography
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: The practice of hiding data within other data such that it is not exposed to any entity other than the intended one is known as steganography. Video steganography is a form of steganography in which private information is embedded into digital video recordings. In the proposed method, the text information is hidden into video frames as well as the audio component of the video. The introduction of randomness in the selection of frames in which information is to be hidden, as well as the use of audio steganography to store additional information aims at boosting security of transmission of information. For additional security, the text is first preprocessed and hashed using the MD5 hashing algorithm before being hidden inside the video components.

articleTitle: SipSmart: Elevating Palates with Machine Learning for Wine Quality Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: This study explores the request of Mechanism Education (ML) techniques for predicting wine quality, aiming to enhance the understanding and precision in assessing the characteristics of different wine varieties. The dataset utilized encompasses diverse oenological parameters, such as acidity, residual sugar, alcohol content, and more. Various ML algorithms, including regression and classification models, were employed to analyze and predict wine quality based on these features. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of ML in discerning patterns and providing accurate predictions, offering valuable insights for both connoisseurs and the wine industry.Wine classification poses a formidable challenge, exacerbated by the elusive criteria that define a good-tasting wine. Certification processes currently rely on subjective sensory analysis conducted by human tasters. To address this, our study aims to predict wine quality, offering a more objective approach. We leveraged a dataset featuring various physicochemical properties of red and white variantsof Portuguese “Vinho Verde” wine, sourced from Kaggle, and utilized Google Colab for analysis. Machine learning algorithms were employed to discern ex- ceptional or subpar wine qualities. Data preprocessing involved identifying and handling missing values, while One-Hot encoding transformed categorical values into numerical ones. Feature Scaling normalized the range of independent variables. Our predictive models, including Logistic Regression, Decision Tree Classifier, Random Forest Classifier, and Extra Trees Classifier, underwent training and evaluation. Comparisons of accuracyand precision guided the selection of the most effective machine learning algorithm. This process enables us to predict wine quality on a scale of 0–10 based on a given set of features. The results contribute to the refinement of wine quality assessment, offering a more standardized and data-driven approach than traditional sensory analysis

articleTitle: Image Enhancement Using Tri-Histogram Equalization Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: Histogram equalization (HE) is essential for correcting digital picture contrast. Conventional HE methods appear weird due to extreme artifacts and brightness changes. Because of its simplicity and effectiveness, histogram equalization is used to increase contrast in many applications. Medical image processing and radar are examples. Due to histogram normalization's flattening, equalization may modify picture brightness. Equalizing may significantly change a picture's brightness; hence video systems never used it. In this paper, a mean and median boundary-oriented equalization technique has been implemented named as image enhancement using tri-histogram equalization technique(IETHE) to improve the picture quality along with brightness control. As per this technique, the input image histogram is partitioned into three sub-histograms using separation threshold settings. The average of mean and median are taken to determine sub-histogram border criteria. The enhanced image is created using transformation function after correcting the sub-histograms. The recommended method boosts visual contrast and control the artifacts and brightness. Both visual quality ratings and quantitative measures like entropy index and PSNR reveal that the recommended strategy beats other techniques.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Foreign Object Debris (FOD) Detection on Runway
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Emerging Smart Computing and Informatics (ESCI)
abstract: An improved method for detecting Foreign Object Debris (FOD) in a runway environment is presented in this paper. The method involves implementing detection model based on deep learning algorithm which can classify and detect object with high accuracy i.e mean Average Precision (mAP). Regular method like radar technology and optical imaging system are used more frequently but these are sensitive to weather and this affects the accuracy. To avoid this Computer Vision (CV) and Machine Learning (ML) are being used.
